item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://securemetawork.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

a:3:{s:11:"plugin_name";s:11:"WooCommerce";s:11:"policy_text";s:4106:"

This sample language includes the basics around what personal data your store may be collecting, storing and sharing, as well as who may have access to that data. Depending on what settings are enabled and which additional plugins are used, the specific information shared by your store will vary. We recommend consulting with a lawyer when deciding what information to disclose on your privacy policy.

We collect information about you during the checkout process on our store.

What we collect and store

While you visit our site, we’ll track:

  • Products you’ve viewed: we’ll use this to, for example, show you products you’ve recently viewed
  • Location, IP address and browser type: we’ll use this for purposes like estimating taxes and shipping
  • Shipping address: we’ll ask you to enter this so we can, for instance, estimate shipping before you place an order, and send you the order!

We’ll also use cookies to keep track of cart contents while you’re browsing our site.

Note: you may want to further detail your cookie policy, and link to that section from here.

When you purchase from us, we’ll ask you to provide information including your name, billing address, shipping address, email address, phone number, credit card/payment details and optional account information like username and password. We’ll use this information for purposes, such as, to:

  • Send you information about your account and order
  • Respond to your requests, including refunds and complaints
  • Process payments and prevent fraud
  • Set up your account for our store
  • Comply with any legal obligations we have, such as calculating taxes
  • Improve our store offerings
  • Send you marketing messages, if you choose to receive them

If you create an account, we will store your name, address, email and phone number, which will be used to populate the checkout for future orders.

We generally store information about you for as long as we need the information for the purposes for which we collect and use it, and we are not legally required to continue to keep it. For example, we will store order information for XXX years for tax and accounting purposes. This includes your name, email address and billing and shipping addresses.

We will also store comments or reviews, if you choose to leave them.

Who on our team has access

Members of our team have access to the information you provide us. For example, both Administrators and Shop Managers can access:

  • Order information like what was purchased, when it was purchased and where it should be sent, and
  • Customer information like your name, email address, and billing and shipping information.

Our team members have access to this information to help fulfill orders, process refunds and support you.

What we share with others

In this section you should list who you’re sharing data with, and for what purpose. This could include, but may not be limited to, analytics, marketing, payment gateways, shipping providers, and third party embeds.

We share information with third parties who help us provide our orders and store services to you; for example --

Payments

In this subsection you should list which third party payment processors you’re using to take payments on your store since these may handle customer data. We’ve included PayPal as an example, but you should remove this if you’re not using PayPal.

We accept payments through PayPal. When processing payments, some of your data will be passed to PayPal, including information required to process or support the payment, such as the purchase total and billing information.

Please see the PayPal Privacy Policy for more details.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.title: MetaProjects
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
MetaProjects - From Physical Tools to Digital Gamepieces

Tools unlock work, whether it's a drill or a gamepiece NFT.

That simple truth sits at the core of both SECURE Tool Company and its sister company, SECURE MetaWork. Where SECURE Tool built expertise renting and moving physical tools to people who need them, MetaJobs applies the exact same playbook to digital tools; gamepiece NFTs that unlock access to in‑game, income‑generating tasks.

When the “job” lives inside a game, the “tool” is your gamepiece: the spaceship, the character, the weapon, the access pass. No tool, no work. MetaJobs bridges that gap by renting the required gamepiece NFTs to MetaWorkers, so anyone can start earning without upfront costs.

Rent the gear, do the job, earn.

Blockchain Projects We Host

Situated in the world of galactic war, Cantina Royale is a top-down tactical arcade shooter game with fully-modelled 3D NFT characters where players earn rewards by battling each other.

At Synesis One, we aspire to build the largest web3 community that can crowdsource the most diverse and high quality data sets to power AI applications.

Hunters On-Chain is a blockchain-based battle royale where players compete against each other and the environment with NFT's representing 40 different classes with hundreds of customizable attributes.

Tools Unlock Work: Physical vs. Digital

Whether it’s a drill on a jobsite or a character in a battle arena. With SECURE Tool Company’s real‑world experience and MetaWorks’ on‑chain automation, anyone, anywhere can pick up the right tool and get to work, any time.

SECURE Tool Company (Physical World)MetaJobs (Digital/Web3)
Tool rental inventoryNFT “tool” inventory (gamepieces, passes, characters)
Kitting & dispatch logisticsNFT delegation and access control to game accounts
Maintenance & readinessMetadata health, cooldown tracking, version updates
Scheduling & utilizationTask matching and yield optimization for NFTs
Rental agreements & paymentsSmart contracts with automatic revenue splits
Safety/trainingIn‑game onboarding, task guides, and reputation tracking
Fraud preventionAnti‑bot checks + gamified worker reliability system

MetaJobs inherits SECURE Tool’s operational DNA and ports it to Web3: the right tool, to the right worker, at the right time, with blockchain transparency and automated payouts.

Who Benefits and How

MetaWorkers

  • No upfront NFT purchases or rental fees.
  • Clear, fair earning splits and automated payouts via smart contracts.
  • Build reputation to unlock access to higher‑tier tools and higher‑paying tasks.

Tool Owners / Investors

  • Put idle NFTs to work and maximize utilization.
  • Automated revenue sharing; transparent on‑chain performance.
  • Diversify across games and tool types; convert earnings into tokenized revenue streams.

Game Studios

  • Lower friction to onboard new players/earners.
  • Reliable “workforce” for events, data, and gameplay loops.
  • Healthy secondary economy that rewards engagement and skill.

item.title: MetaConsulting
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
MetaWork’s Consulting projects provide access to task-based income opportunities that can be completed on your own time, from a mobile phone, earning cryptocurrency for each completed task.

Train diverse, high quality data sets to power AI applications for some of the world's best known brands.

item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Stake Your Earnings With Us

Our Staking Tools provide a hard-to-go-wrong method for earning passive rewards. We work with industry leading partners to ensure that your funds remain safe. By staking with SECURE, you're not only earning interest on your crypto, but you're securing the blockchain and increasing decentralization.

Algorand Staking Pool

The Réti Pooling protocol facilitates the creation of decentralized staking pools on the Algorand network, enabling groups of individuals to participate in consensus together. Users are able to trustlessly stake to a Validator and earn yield based on the rewards the Validator receives.

item.title: 3D Product Design
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Create Original 3D Products & Sell Them Globally

Transform your ideas into physical products using powerful 3D design tools. Whether you're scanning existing objects, sculpting artistic pieces, or engineering functional items, MetaWork connects your 3D creations to customers worldwide.

Your Design Process:

  1. Choose your tool based on what type of product you want to create
  2. Create your 3D model using your selected app:
    • Kiri Engine: Scan your physical object using your phone's camera
    • 3D Modeling App: Sculpt and shape your design using touch controls
    • TinkerCAD: Assemble geometric shapes into functional products
  3. Export your file in STL or OBJ format from your chosen tool
  4. Upload to MetaWork using our 3D product submission system
  5. Set your base pricing - we'll handle the final production pricing & optimization

Ready to create? Choose your design method below:

Kiri Engine: 3D Scanner

  • Best for: Converting physical objects you've already made into sellable 3D files
  • Use when: You have handmade items, prototypes, or existing products to digitize
  • Examples: Sculptures, crafts, tools, decorative items you've created

3D Modelling App

  • Best for: Creating organic, artistic, and decorative products from scratch
  • Use when: Designing jewelry, figurines, artistic pieces, or flowing shapes
  • Examples: Statues, vases, artistic accessories, character models

TinkerCAD

  • Best for: Building functional products using geometric shapes and precise measurements
  • Use when: Creating practical items, replacement parts, or mechanical components
  • Examples: Cabinet handles, organizers, brackets, household tools

After You Upload Your Design

Professional Processing & Optimization:

  1. Structural integrity review - Our experts ensure your design will print successfully
  2. Layout optimization - We fix any printing inefficiencies to reduce costs and improve quality
  3. Professional slicing - Your model is prepared with optimal print settings for best results
  4. Competitive pricing - Leveraging our local manufacturing partnerships for the lowest possible production costs

MetaWork's Manufacturing Advantage:

  • Lowest production prices through direct partnerships with local 3D printing facilities
  • Meticulous quality control ensuring every print meets professional standards
  • 30-day price guarantee - your production costs stay locked for a full month
  • No surprise markups - unlike other platforms that inflate prices to cover printing risks, we guarantee successful prints at transparent pricing

Your Product Goes Live:

  • Dual revenue streams - Earn from both digital file downloads and physical print orders
  • Global marketplace listing - Your optimized product appears immediately after processing
  • Create your 3D Aisle - Showcase all your 3D products in one personalized storefront
  • Guaranteed profitability - Know your exact margins with our locked-in production pricing

Your professionally optimized 3D design will be available for purchase with guaranteed pricing and print success.

item.title: Start Your Business with MetaManufacturing
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Start Your Business with MetaManufacturing

Select designs, artwork, or product templates from global creators and influencers. Customize your own original product lines using those images/products and earn money by selling them with MetaWork!

Customize a Standard Product

Design a product any product from shirts and hats, to mugs and glasses, stickers, magnets and even kitchen cabinet wraps.

  1. Select a standard product from our catalog.
  2. Use the MetaWork Design Engine to design your product using images from global artists and influencers.
  3. Sell your original product via your personal store "Aisle" on MetaWork, or one of our eCommerce platform accounts (eg, Amazon).

Once you finish your design, you can buy it for yourself, or sell it to others with MetaWork!

Select a Product to Customize

Create a 3D Product from Scratch

From fashionable statues and centerpieces, to functional home accessories (eg, cabinet handles) or prosthetic limbs, you can design and sell any product you can imagine by either:

  1. Using a 3D sculpting app on your mobile phone.
  2. Using a CAD program to assemble premade pieces into a finished product on your mobile phone.
  3. Converting a physical product you’ve already made (eg, a spoon, or a statue) into a 3D print file via a mobile 3D scanning app.

Create 3D Design from Scratch

item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Create Anything You Can Imagine!

MetaManufacturing allows you to build an ecommerce business, using our blockchain tools.

You can create products based on our catalog of pre-manufactured SKU or start from scratch with your own 3D models.

Customize Pre-Manufactured SKU!

Make shirts for a family vacation. Launch your own product line! Browse our catalog of customizable products. Then, upload your own image, or select from our library of official NFT mints from your favorite creators, athletes and influencers.

Customize a Product

3D Design Engine

Create and upload your own 3d model, or use one from our catalog. Our 3D Design Engine gives you ultimate control over every aspect of your product.

Create a 3D Product

Sell Your Images and Designs

Save your designs and media IP as an NFT on the blockchain and get paid every time creators use your work.

Create NFT (Coming Soon)

Create Your Product Today!

Register today and use our Blockchain Tools to create, own and sell any product you can imagine!

Regsiter & Create

item.title: Upload Your IP
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Upload Your IP for Approval

Intellectual property (IP): Creations of the mind, such as musical, literary and artistic works.

IP protection in law enables people to earn recognition or financial benefit from what they invent or create. MetaWork provides this protection via "tokenization" (ie, minting NFTs), allowing anyone, anywhere in the world, to earn financial benefit from their intellectual creations; without the need to hire expensive lawyers.

To mint your IP and start earning with MetaWork, fill out the form below, and upload your IP. We're currently only accepting the following 3 file types - jpg, jpeg and png. Once received, a Content Consultant will review your IP and contact you via information on this form with follow-up questions.

Thanks for your interest in earning money from your IP with MetaWork!

MetaWork maintains a professional environment, for all ages, races and genders; free from hate speech, slurs, threats, etc. To maintain this environment, our team of Content Consultants review each submission to ensure it adheres to our guidelines.

[contact-form-7 id="2312eeb" title="IP Upload"]

item.title: MetaSurveys
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
MetaSurvey Opportunities

Unlike task-based MetaJobs, MetaSurveys do not have a standard, guaranteed payment for completion. Payout often varies, and is often rejected based on demographics when completing surveys.

That being said, surveys and games are a great way to earn some extra income while searching for MetaJobs, or waiting for responses from employers.

Current Opportunities

The opportunities below have been approved and are currently open for earning.

5 Surveys

Share your thoughts and insights on various topics and products. 5 Completed surveys means $5 on your balance.

TopSurveys

Top paying surveys with competitive rewards. Access from any device: Mobile, Desktop or Tablet and get paid fast, no waiting periods.

Hey Ca$h

Explore new mobile games, complete in-game challenges, and earn real money. Turn your gaming time into a rewarding experience and maximize your earnings!

Coming Soon!

The opportunities below are being finalized and are currently closed for earning. Check in a couple days to see if they have been approved, and what the payout will be.

*MetaWork does not guarantee payment for any offer completions for any of the "Coming Soon" opportunities below.

The Cint Exchange

The world’s largest global research marketplace. Connecting research questions to millions of respondents across 130 countries – available any time, anywhere.

Prime Opinion

Your opinions are valuable, and businesses are willing to pay for them. Earn cash today simply by voicing your opinions on current affairs, what washing-up liquid you use or what TV you prefer to watch.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
About MetaWork

MetaWork is a platform that gives you access to real economic opportunity—no matter who you are or where you live. Whether you want to earn income, grow a business, invest in physical assets, or secure your creative work, MetaWork puts powerful blockchain tools in your hands.

We believe ACCESS changes everything. Here's what you can do with MetaWork:

ACCESS to WORK

With MetaWork, you can find work, offer services, and build your income—all on your own terms.

  • MetaJobs: Find digital and real-world work opportunities and get paid securely.

  • MetaManufacturing: Upload your original designs, artwork, or product templates, and earn money every time they’re used in merchandise (shirts, mugs, wall posters, etc.).

  • MetaFinance: Invest in community-driven projects, from livestock to local businesses, and grow your earnings.

You own what you earn. All assets—whether it's a paycheck, a product, or an investment—are tracked securely and transparently on the blockchain.

ACCESS to OWNERSHIP

MetaWork lets you prove and protect ownership of anything valuable through digital certificates called NFTs.

You can mint NFTs for:

  • Creative Work – like photos, music, 3D designs, or writing.

  • Real-World Assets (RWAs) – like livestock, real estate, or shares in a local business.

Your NFT shows when you became the owner and automatically tracks revenue. For example, if you mint an NFT for a photo you took, it not only proves you own it—it can also collect income from every sale of that photo online (via Etsy, eBay, Amazon, etc.).

ACCESS to TOOLS

You get the tools to store, manage, and grow your assets—all with the highest level of security available, including quantum-proof (resistant to future hacking technologies) blockchain protection.

Your toolbox includes:

  • Blockchain Wallet (e.g., Pera Wallet) – Securely store and send stablecoins, NFTs, and crypto. Use it to approve transactions like staking crypto assets for passive income.

  • IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) – Store your files (e.g., 3D designs, videos) in a decentralized, tamper-proof cloud. Only you—and those you approve—can access your content.

  • Real-World Asset Tokenization (RWA) – Invest in physical assets globally. Fund a bakery in Tucson or buy into livestock farming in Nigeria. Earnings are stored transparently and returned to you automatically.

  • Financial Instruments – Earn passive income through staking, lend or borrow against your crypto, and trade securely—all from your dashboard.

You control your assets. Whether you’re off-ramping crypto into your local currency to pay rent or creating smart contracts to fund a new business, MetaWork gives you freedom and flexibility.

ACCESS to TRAINING

You don’t have to figure it out alone. With MetaWork TV, you get access to live events and weekly training to help you reach your financial and business goals.

Learn how to:

  • Set up your wallet and mint NFTs

  • Start earning through MetaJobs or MetaManufacturing

  • Trade crypto and equities

  • Use blockchain tools for passive income

The future of work and finance is decentralized. Our programs ensure you stay ahead of the curve.

Build Your Future with MetaWork

MetaWork exists to put power, ownership, and opportunity in your hands. Whether you're a freelancer, entrepreneur, investor, or artist—this is your platform to thrive.

item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
MetaWork Design Engine User Guide

Design Engine Tools

Learn what options are available for you to create the visuals of your own unique product design.

  • Templates, Clipart and Images (TCI)
  • Product - Product options like size, color, etc.
  • Text - Select what font your product uses
  • Shapes - Add basic shapes to your design
  • Layers - Easily edit your design via layers
  • Drawing - Freestyle drawing tool

Design Engine Canvas

Step-by-step guide to navigating the MetaWork Design Engine Canvas as you make your own unique products.

  • Image Toolbar - (Replace, Crop, Mask, Remove Background, Filters)
  • Layout Toolbar - (Fill Color, Arrange Layers, Position, Transform)
  • Text Toolbar - (Font Family, Advanced Font, Text Effects, Text Style)

item.title: Confirm Your IP Approval
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Congratulations on being approved!

After careful review, we've determined that your IP submission adheres our rigorous standards.

As the next step, we need to verify the information in the form below. Without the correct Algorand wallet address, we will be unable to pay you for any IP sales.

Once we receive this information, a couple of things will happen in the next 48 - 72 hours:

  • Our Minting Team will begin the process of establishing YOUR OWNERSHIP of the IP on the blockchain, making it transparent to the world this is YOUR IP*.
  • Your IP images will be uploaded into our Design Engine to be purchased and used by product designers.
  • You will receive a link to your own "Aisle" where all your IP/products will be displayed for purchase.

Thanks for your interest in monetizing your IP with MetaWork!

*This is a technical process that is 100% managed by our team. As minting technology develops, we will give MetaWorkers the ability to mint their own IP.

[contact-form-7 id="3ff0de2" title="IP Acceptance Form"]

  • Our Minting Team will begin the process of establishing YOUR OWNERSHIP of the IP on the blockchain, making it transparent to the world this is YOUR IP*<\/strong><\/em>.<\/li>
  • Your IP images will be uploaded into our Design Engine to be purchased and used by product designers.<\/li>
  • You will receive a link to your own \"Aisle\" where all your IP\/products will be displayed for purchase.<\/li><\/ul>

    Thanks for your interest in monetizing your IP with MetaWork!<\/p>

    *This is a technical process that is 100% managed by our team. As minting technology develops, we will give MetaWorkers the ability to mint their own IP.<\/i><\/b><\/p>"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false},{"id":"4a0d2b7","elType":"container","settings":[],"elements":[{"id":"813eb6c","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[contact-form-7 id=\"3ff0de2\" title=\"IP Acceptance Form\"]"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Create Your Own Product Lines
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Create Anything You Can Imagine!

MetaManufacturing allows you to build an ecommerce business, using our blockchain tools.

You can create products based on our catalog of pre-manufactured SKU or start from scratch with your own 3D models.

Step 1 - Select Product

Shirts, mugs, wall posters and pet bowls. We have dozens of product categories for you to choose from.

Check our the button below to see our full lineup of products, waiting to bring your ideas to life.

Customize a Product

Step 2 - Design

Use images from global artists, creators and influencers, or upload your own. Our robust Design Engine allows you to add text, shapes, change colors, edit layers and more.

Feeling overwhelmed? Check out the button below for step-by-step guides of each feature.

Creating Your First Product

Step 3 - Submit Product

Submit your product right from the design canvas! Answer some basic sales questions and name your selling price!

Behind the scenes, our Product Review Team will create an "Aisle" for your products and integrate them into our regional manufacturing supply chain partners so that we're ready to produce and ship to your customers.

Step 4 - Sell

Once approved, you'll receive a link to a page, via both email and MetaWork DM, that has all your products displayed and available for purchase.

This is your "Aisle." You should share this link with family, friends and followers. Don't worry about shipping to your customers, we'll do that for you.

Check out a sample "Aisle" by following the button below.

See a Creator's Aisle

Step 5 - Get Paid

When you make a sale, you'll receive a blockchain stablecoin payment in your "wallet."

We use blockchain because it's fastest (~3 sec), cheapest (< $0.01), most secure and transparent way to send money. We send stablecoins because their value is stable (1 USDC = $1 USD).

Don't know what a wallet is? It's easy. Just check out the button below.

Get Your Wallet

Create Your First Product Today

The best way to get started is to dive right in.

Head over to our Design Engine and start creating, today!

CREATE MY FIRST PRODUCT

item.title: MetaSwap Tools
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
MetaDex Swap

MetaDEX Swap gives you ACCESS to the most popular blockchains, stablecoins and trending tokens with over 319,000 exchange pairs, with new assets constantly being added.

Swap your MetaWork earnings for stablecoin (to avoid price drops) or invest in that altcoin that you've been watching, waiting for a good entry price.

Don't know what to invest in? No problem. Attend our MetaInvesting classes every Wed. at 11am GMT -7 on MetaTalk!

How to Use MetaDEX Swap

  1. Select the currency you wish to sell. SOL is listed by default.
  2. Select the currency you wish to receive. ALGO is selected by default.
  3. After pressing "Exchange," you'll be prompted to enter the RECEIVING wallet address.
  4. Next, you will send the assets you're SELLING to the address given.
  5. Swaps can take from two to twenty minutes, depending on how long it takes for a block to complete. Most orders process in just a few minutes.

Dedicated Algorand Swaps

Our dedicated ALGO swap is a next-generation decentralized Automated Market Maker (AMM) on the Algorand blockchain.

You get ACCESS to better prices because our swap router utilizes both on-chain and off-chain components to check multiple pools and alternative routes, finding the best prices to maximize the amount of assets you get when swapping.

How to Use Algorand Swaps

DO NOT SWAP NON-ALGORAND ASSETS! YOU WILL LOSE YOUR MONEY!

  1. Connect your wallet
    • For Mobile: Open your Pera Wallet browser and open the "Trading & Swaps" menu tab. Press "Connect to a wallet."
    • For laptop: Open the "Trading & Swaps" menu tab and press "Connect to a wallet." Scan the QR code with your Pera Wallet app.
  2. Enter the asset wish to SELL in at the top. By default it's ALGO.
  3. Enter the asset you wish RECEIVE on the bottom. By default it's USDC.

item.title: UNIVERSITY PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
University Programs

MetaWork for Universities: Preparing Students for the Future Economy

Bridge the Gap Between Education and Real-World Opportunity

In today's rapidly evolving digital economy, universities face the challenge of preparing students for careers that may not even exist yet. MetaWork provides universities with a comprehensive blockchain-powered platform that connects academic learning with real economic opportunities.

Why Partner with MetaWork?

  • Real-World Experience: Students gain practical experience in blockchain technology, digital entrepreneurship, and global commerce while still in school
  • Income Opportunities: Enable students to earn while they learn through MetaJobs and MetaManufacturing
  • Research Applications: Provide faculty and graduate students with tools to tokenize and monetize research outputs
  • Career Readiness: Equip graduates with in-demand blockchain skills and portfolio pieces that demonstrate real-world application
  • Financial Literacy: Teach students practical financial management through MetaFinance tools

Our University Solutions Include:

  1. MetaWork Campus Portal: A customized platform for your university where students can access blockchain-based opportunities
  2. Curriculum Integration: Resources to incorporate MetaWork tools into business, computer science, art, and economics courses
  3. Campus Creator Program: Support for student entrepreneurs to develop and monetize their creative work
  4. Research Tokenization: Tools for faculty and graduate students to tokenize research outputs as NFTs
  5. University Investment Pool: Opportunities for endowment diversification through tokenized real-world assets

Vision Story: Midwest State University

Students in MSU's Digital Marketing program used MetaManufacturing to design and sell university-themed merchandise, earning over $15,000 in their first semester while gaining practical experience in product design, marketing, and blockchain technology.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking universities already preparing their students for the decentralized economy. Contact our education team to schedule a demonstration and consultation.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork University Program: "Blockchain Entrepreneurship Academy"

Program Duration: 12-week modular program (can be integrated into existing courses or offered as a standalone certificate)

Program Goals:

  • Introduce students to blockchain technology and its practical applications
  • Provide hands-on experience with MetaWork's platform
  • Enable students to earn income through blockchain-based opportunities
  • Develop entrepreneurial skills for the digital economy

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies
  • Understanding wallets, transactions, and security
  • Setting up personal blockchain wallets
  • Hands-on: Complete first blockchain transaction

Module 2: Digital Work Opportunities (3 weeks)

  • Exploring MetaJobs platform
  • Types of digital work available globally
  • Completing tasks and earning crypto
  • Portfolio building and reputation management
  • Hands-on: Complete 5 MetaJobs tasks and earn first payment

Module 3: Creative Monetization (3 weeks)

  • Introduction to NFTs and digital ownership
  • Using MetaManufacturing to monetize creative work
  • IP protection and licensing in the digital economy
  • Marketing strategies for digital products
  • Hands-on: Create and list original design on MetaManufacturing

Module 4: Financial Literacy & Investment (3 weeks)

  • Understanding digital assets and tokenization
  • Introduction to MetaFinance tools
  • Risk assessment and portfolio diversification
  • Real-world asset tokenization and investment
  • Hands-on: Create a mock investment portfolio with tokenized assets

Module 5: Capstone Project (1 week)

  • Students develop a comprehensive blockchain-based business plan
  • Presentation to peers and potential investors
  • Implementation roadmap using MetaWork tools

Assessment Methods:

  • Practical assignments using MetaWork platform (60%)
  • Capstone project and presentation (30%)
  • Participation and peer collaboration (10%)

Resources Provided:

  • MetaWork University Portal access for all students
  • Starter crypto allocation for hands-on activities
  • Guest lectures from blockchain entrepreneurs
  • Mentorship from MetaWork experts

item.title: HIGH SCHOOL PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
HIGH SCHOOL PROGRAMS

MetaWork for High Schools: Preparing the Next Generation for Digital Success

Equip Students with Future-Ready Skills

Today's high school students are digital natives who need more than traditional education to thrive in tomorrow's economy. MetaWork provides high schools with age-appropriate blockchain tools that introduce students to digital entrepreneurship, financial literacy, and creative monetization.

Why Bring MetaWork to Your High School?

  • Practical Tech Education: Move beyond theory with hands-on blockchain applications
  • Financial Literacy: Teach students about digital assets, investing, and personal finance
  • Entrepreneurial Skills: Enable students to design products and monetize their creativity
  • College Readiness: Give students portfolio-building opportunities that stand out on applications
  • Inclusive Opportunity: Provide all students access to emerging economic opportunities, regardless of background

Our High School Solutions Include:

  1. MetaWork Education Portal: A secure, monitored platform designed specifically for high school students
  2. Classroom Curriculum: Grade-appropriate lesson plans aligned with STEM, business, and art standards
  3. Student Enterprise Program: Framework for student-run businesses using MetaManufacturing
  4. Financial Literacy Module: Interactive tools teaching digital economy concepts
  5. Teacher Training: Professional development for educators to confidently guide students

Vision Story: Washington Heights High School

Students in WHHS's business program launched a school merchandise store using MetaManufacturing, designing and selling products that generated funds for their robotics team while learning practical business and technology skills.

Safe, Secure, and Educational

Our high school platform includes enhanced safety features, parental controls, and educational guardrails to ensure an age-appropriate learning environment.

Get Started Today

Join innovative high schools preparing students for the future economy. Contact our education team to learn how MetaWork can enhance your curriculum.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork High School Program: "Digital Economy Foundations"

Program Duration: Semester-long course (18 weeks) with flexible implementation options

Program Goals:

  • Introduce high school students to blockchain technology and digital economy concepts

  • Build financial literacy for the digital age
  • Create portfolio-worthy projects for college applications

  • Evolution of money and commerce
  • Basics of blockchain technology (simplified for high school level)
  • Digital identity and security fundamentals

Module 2: Creative Digital Skills (4 weeks)

  • Introduction to digital design principles

  • Understanding intellectual property rights

Module 3: Entrepreneurship Basics (4 weeks)

  • Identifying market opportunities
  • Product development and pricing strategies
  • Marketing in the digital economy
  • Team collaboration and project management

Module 4: Financial Literacy (4 weeks)

  • Personal finance fundamentals
  • Introduction to digital assets and investments
  • Risk assessment and management
  • Saving and investing strategies
  • Hands-on: Create a simulated investment portfolio with teacher guidance

Module 5: Capstone Project (3 weeks)

  • Student teams develop a business concept using MetaWork tools
  • Implementation of a limited product launch
  • Analysis of results and presentation of findings
  • Hands-on: Launch a real product with proceeds benefiting school or community

Assessment Methods:

  • Project-based assessments (50%)
  • Digital portfolio development (25%)
  • Participation and teamwork (15%)
  • Final presentation (10%)

Safety and Oversight Features:

  • School-administered accounts with appropriate permissions
  • Parent/guardian notification and consent system
  • Educational-only implementation of blockchain features
  • Teacher dashboard for monitoring student activities

Resources Provided:

  • MetaWork High School Portal licenses
  • Teacher training and support materials
  • Curriculum aligned with educational standards
  • Guest speaker opportunities from industry professionals

item.title: HOMESCHOOL PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
HOMESCHOOL PROGRAMS

MetaWork for Homeschool Families: Real-World Learning for the Digital Age

Bring Practical Economic Education into Your Homeschool Curriculum

Homeschool families excel at providing personalized education that prepares students for real-world success. MetaWork offers homeschool educators and students a powerful platform to explore blockchain technology, digital entrepreneurship, and financial literacy through hands-on learning experiences.

Why Choose MetaWork for Your Homeschool?

  • Practical Technology Education: Move beyond theory with real blockchain applications
  • Entrepreneurial Skill Development: Enable students to create and sell products globally
  • Financial Independence Training: Teach valuable money management skills for the digital economy
  • Portfolio Building: Help students develop impressive projects for college applications
  • Family Business Opportunities: Create potential income streams while learning together

Our Homeschool Solutions Include:

  1. Family Learning Portal: A secure platform where parents can guide children through blockchain learning
  2. Flexible Curriculum Resources: Self-paced modules adaptable to your educational approach
  3. Project-Based Learning: Real-world applications that integrate multiple subject areas
  4. Parent-Guided Financial Tools: Age-appropriate financial education with parental oversight
  5. Homeschool Community: Connect with other families exploring blockchain education

Vision Story: The Martinez Family

The Martinez family integrated MetaWork into their curriculum for their three teenagers. Together, they designed and sold custom educational materials through MetaManufacturing, earning over $2,000 while learning practical business, design, and technology skills that complemented their core academic subjects.

Flexible Implementation for Any Homeschool Approach

Whether you follow classical education, unschooling, or any approach in between, MetaWork's resources can be tailored to fit your family's educational philosophy and goals.

Get Started Today

Join homeschool families already preparing their students for success in the digital economy. Contact our education team for a demonstration and homeschool-specific consultation.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Homeschool Program: "Family Digital Enterprise"

Program Duration: Flexible, self-paced program designed for 6-9 months of implementation

Program Goals:

  • Provide homeschool families with practical blockchain education
  • Develop entrepreneurial and creative skills through real-world projects
  • Build financial literacy appropriate for various age levels
  • Create potential family micro-business opportunities
  • Integrate technology education with core academic subjects

Module 1: Blockchain Foundations for Families (Flexible timing)

  • Age-appropriate introduction to blockchain technology
  • Family digital security practices
  • Setting up and managing family wallets
  • Cross-curricular connections: mathematics, economics, history
  • Hands-on: Complete family blockchain scavenger hunt and first transactions

Module 2: Creative Skills Development (Flexible timing)

  • Digital design fundamentals for various ages
  • Identifying marketable skills and interests
  • Intellectual property concepts for young creators
  • Cross-curricular connections: art, writing, computer skills
  • Hands-on: Create family or individual designs using MetaManufacturing tools

Module 3: Family Entrepreneurship (Flexible timing)

  • Identifying market opportunities aligned with family values
  • Product development and pricing strategies
  • Marketing fundamentals and ethical business practices
  • Cross-curricular connections: business, communication, ethics
  • Hands-on: Develop and launch a family product line on MetaManufacturing

Module 4: Financial Stewardship (Flexible timing)

  • Values-based approach to money management
  • Digital asset fundamentals for different age levels
  • Saving, giving, and investing principles
  • Cross-curricular connections: mathematics, character education
  • Hands-on: Create age-appropriate financial plans with parent guidance

Module 5: Family Enterprise Project (Flexible timing)

  • Collaborative family business planning
  • Implementation of a real product or service
  • Documentation of learning and outcomes
  • Cross-curricular connections: multiple subjects based on project
  • Hands-on: Launch and manage a real family micro-business

Implementation Approaches:

  • Weekly dedicated "business/technology day"
  • Integration with existing curriculum
  • Summer intensive project
  • Co-op implementation with multiple families

Parent Resources:

  • Comprehensive guide for leading blockchain discussions
  • Age-appropriate activity modifications
  • Subject integration suggestions
  • Assessment rubrics and portfolio development tools

Community Support:

  • Monthly virtual meetups with other homeschool families
  • Mentor matching with experienced homeschool entrepreneurs
  • Showcase opportunities for student projects
  • Homeschool-specific forum for questions and collaboration

item.title: NGO AND CHARITIES
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
NGO AND CHARITIES PROGRAMS

MetaWork for NGOs and Charities: Blockchain Solutions for Global Impact

Transform How You Fund, Operate, and Measure Your Mission

Non-profit organizations face unique challenges in funding, transparency, and impact measurement. MetaWork provides NGOs and charities with blockchain-powered tools to revolutionize how you raise funds, create economic opportunities for beneficiaries, and demonstrate your impact to stakeholders.

Why Partner with MetaWork?

  • Transparent Fundraising: Build donor trust with fully traceable donations and expenditures
  • Beneficiary Empowerment: Provide economic opportunities directly to those you serve
  • Operational Efficiency: Reduce administrative costs with automated smart contracts
  • Global Accessibility: Reach underserved populations without traditional banking access
  • Impact Verification: Document and verify outcomes with immutable blockchain records

Our NGO Solutions Include:

  1. Transparent Donation Platform: Allow donors to track their contributions from receipt to impact
  2. Beneficiary Opportunity Portal: Provide those you serve with access to MetaJobs and MetaManufacturing
  3. Tokenized Impact Certificates: Create verifiable NFTs documenting your organization's outcomes
  4. Micro-Grant Distribution: Efficiently distribute small grants to beneficiaries globally
  5. Community Asset Tokenization: Help communities tokenize and monetize local resources

Vision Story: Clean Water Initiative

CWI used MetaWork to tokenize community-owned water purification systems in rural Kenya. Local residents received ownership shares as NFTs and earn income from system operations, while donors can track exactly how their contributions created sustainable impact.

Compliance and Reporting

Our platform includes specialized tools for non-profit compliance, impact reporting, and donor communication, making it easier to fulfill your mission while meeting regulatory requirements.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking NGOs already leveraging blockchain for greater impact. Contact our non-profit team for a consultation tailored to your organization's mission.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork NGO Program: "Blockchain for Social Impact"

Program Duration: Modular implementation over 3-6 months

Program Goals:

  • Equip NGO staff with blockchain knowledge relevant to social impact
  • Implement transparent fundraising and reporting systems
  • Create economic opportunities for beneficiaries
  • Develop impact measurement frameworks using blockchain
  • Build organizational capacity for blockchain integration

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for Social Impact (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain for non-profit applications
  • Understanding digital wallets and transactions
  • Security and compliance considerations
  • Hands-on: Set up organizational wallets and complete test transactions

Module 2: Transparent Fundraising Implementation (4 weeks)

  • Donor-facing blockchain integration
  • Setting up transparent fund tracking
  • Smart contract development for programmatic spending
  • Donor communication strategies
  • Hands-on: Configure donation tracking system for your organization

Module 3: Beneficiary Opportunity Creation (4 weeks)

  • Assessing beneficiary digital readiness
  • Setting up MetaJobs access for beneficiaries
  • Training frameworks for digital skills
  • Monitoring and support systems
  • Hands-on: Onboard initial beneficiary group to MetaJobs platform

Module 4: Impact Verification and Reporting (3 weeks)

  • Designing blockchain-based impact metrics
  • Creating verifiable impact NFTs
  • Integrating with existing monitoring and evaluation
  • Stakeholder reporting using blockchain data
  • Hands-on: Develop impact verification system for a current project

Module 5: Asset Tokenization for Communities (3 weeks)

  • Identifying community assets for tokenization
  • Legal and ethical considerations
  • Community ownership structures
  • Revenue distribution models
  • Hands-on: Create tokenization plan for a community asset

Implementation Support:

  • Dedicated NGO implementation specialist
  • Weekly progress check-ins
  • Customization for specific organizational needs
  • Stakeholder education materials

Measurement Framework:

  • Pre/post organizational blockchain readiness assessment
  • Beneficiary economic opportunity tracking
  • Donor engagement metrics
  • Operational efficiency improvements
  • Impact verification effectiveness

Resources Provided:

  • NGO-specific implementation guides
  • Beneficiary training materials in multiple languages
  • Donor education resources
  • Compliance documentation templates
  • Case studies from similar organizations

SPORTS TEAMS PROGRAMS

MetaWork for Sports Teams: Revolutionize Athlete Development and Team Economics

Empower Athletes and Transform Team Operations with Blockchain Technology

From high school leagues to university programs and amateur clubs, sports teams face challenges in athlete development, fundraising, and community engagement. MetaWork provides teams with blockchain-powered tools to create new revenue streams, enhance athlete opportunities, and build stronger connections with fans.

Why Bring MetaWork to Your Team?

  • Athlete Economic Empowerment: Help athletes develop income streams and financial literacy
  • Team Fundraising Innovation: Create new funding mechanisms through tokenized assets
  • Fan Engagement Revolution: Deepen connections with supporters through digital ownership
  • Performance Documentation: Securely record and verify athlete achievements and statistics
  • Community Building: Strengthen team identity and supporter relationships

Our Sports Solutions Include:

  1. Athlete Opportunity Portal: Custom platform for athletes to access MetaJobs and MetaManufacturing
  2. Team Tokenization: Create team-branded digital assets and merchandise
  3. Performance NFTs: Document athlete achievements with verifiable digital certificates
  4. Fan Engagement System: Connect supporters directly with team initiatives
  5. Team Fundraising Platform: Innovative blockchain-based fundraising tools

Vision Story: Westlake High School Basketball

The Westlake Warriors used MetaWork to create team-branded merchandise through MetaManufacturing. Athletes designed products that generated over $25,000 in revenue, with proceeds supporting team expenses and providing athletes with valuable business experience.

For All Levels of Competition

Our solutions scale to fit teams at any level—from youth leagues to university programs—with appropriate features and compliance considerations for each.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking sports programs already leveraging blockchain technology. Contact our sports team specialists for a consultation tailored to your program's needs.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Sports Program: "Athlete Economic Empowerment"

Program Duration: Season-long implementation (3-6 months)

Program Goals:

  • Develop athlete financial literacy and entrepreneurial skills
  • Create team-based economic opportunities
  • Build athlete personal branding capabilities
  • Implement innovative team fundraising mechanisms
  • Enhance fan and community engagement

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for Athletes (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology for sports applications
  • Digital wallet setup and security
  • Understanding digital assets and ownership
  • Hands-on: Complete wallet setup and first transactions

Module 2: Athlete Brand Development (3 weeks)

  • Personal brand fundamentals for athletes
  • Digital content creation basics
  • Intellectual property concepts for sports
  • NIL considerations (for applicable programs)
  • Hands-on: Create personal brand assets using MetaWork tools

Module 3: Team Merchandise Creation (4 weeks)

  • Collaborative design principles
  • Team branding guidelines and applications
  • Product development and pricing strategies
  • Marketing fundamentals for team merchandise
  • Hands-on: Design and launch team merchandise collection

Module 4: Performance Documentation (Ongoing)

  • Identifying key performance metrics
  • Creating verifiable achievement NFTs
  • Building a digital performance portfolio
  • College recruitment applications (where applicable)
  • Hands-on: Mint achievement NFTs for season milestones

Module 5: Team Fundraising Innovation (4 weeks)

  • Traditional vs. blockchain fundraising approaches
  • Tokenized fundraising campaigns
  • Community engagement strategies
  • Transparent fund management
  • Hands-on: Implement blockchain-based team fundraiser

Implementation Approach:

  • Weekly team sessions (30-45 minutes)
  • Individual athlete development plans
  • Coach/administrator dashboard for oversight
  • Parent/guardian education components

Athlete Development Tracking:

  • Financial literacy assessment (pre/post)
  • Entrepreneurial skill development
  • Digital portfolio creation
  • Revenue generation metrics
  • College/career readiness indicators (where applicable)

Resources Provided:

  • Sport-specific implementation guides
  • Age-appropriate financial literacy materials
  • Design templates for team merchandise
  • Marketing playbooks for fundraising campaigns
  • Parent/guardian education resources

item.title: COMMUNITY ORGANIZATION
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
COMMUNITY ORGANIZATION

MetaWork for Community Organizations: Strengthen Local Impact with Global Technology

Empower Your Community with Blockchain-Based Opportunities

Libraries, scout troops, community centers, and local organizations are the backbone of thriving communities. MetaWork provides these vital organizations with blockchain-powered tools to create economic opportunities, enhance programming, and strengthen community bonds through innovative technology.

Why Partner with MetaWork?

  • Digital Literacy Expansion: Introduce community members to essential blockchain skills
  • Economic Opportunity Creation: Provide access to global earning opportunities
  • Program Enhancement: Offer cutting-edge technology workshops and activities
  • Fundraising Innovation: Implement transparent, efficient fundraising mechanisms
  • Community Asset Development: Help community members monetize skills and resources

Our Community Solutions Include:

  1. Community Access Portal: Custom platform for members to access MetaWork opportunities
  2. Digital Literacy Curriculum: Age-appropriate blockchain education for various audiences
  3. Community Creator Program: Tools for local artisans and creators to monetize their work
  4. Organization Tokenization: Create organization-branded digital assets and merchandise
  5. Community Project Funding: Blockchain-based tools for transparent local initiatives

Vision Story: Oakdale Public Library

Oakdale Library implemented MetaWork's digital literacy program, teaching community members how to access online work opportunities through MetaJobs. Participants earned over $15,000 collectively in their first three months, while the library established itself as a digital opportunity hub for the community.

Accessible for All Community Members

Our solutions are designed to be inclusive, with options for various technical skill levels, ages, and backgrounds—ensuring no community member is left behind.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking community organizations already leveraging blockchain for local impact. Contact our community specialists for a consultation tailored to your organization's mission.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Community Program: "Digital Opportunity Hub"

Program Duration: 12-week initial implementation with ongoing support

Program Goals:

  • Introduce community members to blockchain technology and opportunities
  • Develop practical digital skills for economic advancement
  • Create sustainable income streams for participants
  • Enhance organizational programming with cutting-edge technology
  • Build community capacity for digital economy participation

Module 1: Digital Literacy Foundations (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology and digital economy
  • Digital wallet setup and security basics
  • Online safety and privacy fundamentals
  • Hands-on: Complete guided wallet setup and first transactions

Module 2: Economic Opportunity Access (3 weeks)

  • Introduction to MetaJobs platform
  • Finding and evaluating online work opportunities
  • Building digital work profiles and reputations
  • Time management and productivity skills
  • Hands-on: Complete first MetaJobs tasks and earn initial payment

Module 3: Creative Skills Development (3 weeks)

  • Digital design fundamentals for beginners
  • Identifying marketable creative skills
  • Using MetaManufacturing tools for product creation
  • Basic marketing concepts for creators
  • Hands-on: Design and list first product on MetaManufacturing

Module 4: Community Asset Development (2 weeks)

  • Identifying community strengths and resources
  • Collaborative project planning
  • Tokenization concepts for community assets
  • Sustainable revenue models for community projects
  • Hands-on: Develop community asset tokenization plan

Module 5: Program Sustainability (2 weeks)

  • Peer mentorship development
  • Creating ongoing support structures
  • Measuring and communicating impact
  • Expanding program reach
  • Hands-on: Design community-led continuation plan

Implementation Models:

  • Weekly workshop series
  • Intergenerational mentoring program
  • Drop-in digital opportunity hours
  • Youth-focused after-school program
  • Senior digital literacy initiative

Participant Support:

  • Multilingual resources
  • Tiered skill level approaches
  • Peer mentorship system
  • Progress tracking tools
  • Community celebration events

Resources Provided:

  • Facilitator guides for different audiences
  • Participant workbooks (digital and print)
  • Marketing materials for program promotion
  • Impact measurement tools
  • Technology access recommendations

item.title: ART GALLERY PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
ART GALLERY PROGRAMS

MetaWork for Art Galleries: Bridge Physical and Digital Art Worlds

Expand Your Gallery's Reach and Revenue with Blockchain Innovation

Today's art world spans both physical and digital realms, creating new challenges and opportunities for galleries. MetaWork provides art galleries with blockchain-powered tools to authenticate artwork, create new revenue streams, and connect with global collectors while maintaining the integrity of artistic expression.

Why Partner with MetaWork?

  • Artwork Authentication: Create verifiable provenance records for physical and digital art
  • Artist Empowerment: Help represented artists monetize their work in new ways
  • Revenue Diversification: Develop additional income streams beyond traditional sales
  • Global Collector Access: Connect with art enthusiasts worldwide through blockchain
  • Exhibition Enhancement: Create immersive experiences bridging physical and digital art

Our Gallery Solutions Include:

  1. Art Authentication System: Tools to create verifiable provenance NFTs for artwork
  2. Artist Opportunity Portal: Platform for gallery artists to access MetaManufacturing
  3. Gallery Tokenization: Create gallery-branded digital assets and limited editions
  4. Collector Engagement System: Connect directly with collectors through blockchain
  5. Exhibition Enhancement Tools: Bridge physical shows with digital experiences

Vision Story: Riverside Contemporary Gallery

Riverside Contemporary used MetaWork to create authenticated NFTs for their physical exhibition pieces, allowing collectors to purchase both the physical artwork and its digital certificate. Artists received additional revenue through MetaManufacturing, creating limited edition merchandise based on their original works.

Preserving Artistic Integrity

Our solutions are designed with respect for artistic vision and gallery curation, ensuring that blockchain technology enhances rather than compromises the art experience.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking galleries already bridging physical and digital art worlds. Contact our arts specialists for a consultation tailored to your gallery's vision.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Art Gallery Program: "Blockchain Art Innovation"

Program Duration: 8-week implementation with ongoing support

Program Goals:

  • Introduce gallery staff and artists to blockchain applications for art
  • Implement artwork authentication and provenance systems
  • Develop new revenue streams through digital art opportunities
  • Enhance collector engagement through blockchain technology
  • Create innovative exhibition experiences bridging physical and digital art

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for Art (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology for art applications
  • NFTs and digital art fundamentals
  • Authentication and provenance concepts
  • Hands-on: Create first gallery wallet and complete test transactions

Module 2: Artwork Authentication Implementation (2 weeks)

  • Designing authentication workflows for gallery pieces
  • Creating verifiable provenance records
  • Connecting physical art with digital certificates
  • Legal and copyright considerations
  • Hands-on: Create authentication NFTs for selected gallery works

Module 3: Artist Opportunity Development (2 weeks)

  • Introducing artists to MetaManufacturing
  • Digital reproduction and licensing strategies
  • Limited edition creation and management
  • Artist royalty structures
  • Hands-on: Onboard first artists to MetaManufacturing platform

Module 4: Collector Engagement Enhancement (1 week)

  • Building blockchain-savvy collector communities
  • Digital wallet guidance for traditional collectors
  • Creating exclusive collector experiences
  • Transparent sales and provenance tracking
  • Hands-on: Implement collector engagement system for upcoming exhibition

Module 5: Exhibition Innovation (1 week)

  • Designing hybrid physical/digital exhibitions
  • QR integration for artwork information
  • Interactive digital components for physical shows
  • Virtual exhibition extensions
  • Hands-on: Plan blockchain components for next gallery exhibition

Implementation Support:

  • Dedicated art specialist consultant
  • Artist onboarding assistance
  • Collector education materials
  • Technical integration guidance
  • Marketing support for blockchain initiatives

Measurement Framework:

  • New revenue stream tracking
  • Artist satisfaction assessment
  • Collector engagement metrics
  • Authentication system effectiveness
  • Exhibition attendance and engagement

Resources Provided:

  • Gallery-specific implementation guides
  • Artist onboarding materials
  • Collector education resources
  • Exhibition planning templates
  • Case studies from similar galleries

NIL & NCAA PROGRAMS

MetaWork for NIL Athletes: Maximize Your Name, Image, and Likeness Potential

Build Your Brand, Monetize Your Influence, and Prepare for Your Future

The NIL era has created unprecedented opportunities for NCAA athletes to benefit from their name, image, and likeness. MetaWork provides college athletes with blockchain-powered tools to build their personal brand, create sustainable income streams, and develop business skills that last beyond their athletic career.

Why Choose MetaWork as an NIL Athlete?

  • Brand Ownership: Secure verifiable ownership of your name, image, and likeness as NFTs

  • Transparent Partnerships: Implement clear, automated agreements with sponsors
  • Fan Engagement: Connect directly with supporters through blockchain-based experiences
  • Future Preparation: Develop business and financial skills for long-term success

Our NIL Athlete Solutions Include:

Full NCAA Compliance

item.title: MUSIC INDUSTRY PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
MUSIC INDUSTRY PROGRAMS

MetaWork for the Music Industry: Revolutionize Your Sound, Rights, and Revenue

Empower Artists with Direct Ownership and New Revenue Streams

The music industry continues to evolve in the digital age, with artists seeking greater control over their work and more direct connections with fans. MetaWork provides musicians, producers, and labels with blockchain-powered tools to secure rights, create new revenue streams, and build sustainable careers independent of traditional gatekeepers.

Why Choose MetaWork for Your Music Career?

  • Rights Protection: Secure verifiable ownership of your compositions and recordings as NFTs
  • Direct Monetization: Sell music, merchandise, and experiences without intermediaries
  • Royalty Automation: Receive payments instantly when your music is used or streamed
  • Fan Relationships: Build direct connections with supporters through blockchain experiences
  • Catalog Valuation: Create transparent, tradable assets from your music catalog

Our Music Industry Solutions Include:

  1. Music Rights Portal: Secure platform to register and protect your compositions and recordings
  2. Artist Monetization Suite: Tools to create and sell music, merchandise, and experiences
  3. Royalty Smart Contracts: Automated, transparent payment distribution for collaborations
  4. Fan Engagement System: Connect directly with listeners through exclusive blockchain experiences
  5. Music Catalog Tokenization: Convert your catalog into investable assets with ongoing royalties

Vision Story: Indie Artist Collective

A group of independent hip-hop artists used MetaWork to create a collaborative album where each track was minted as an NFT. Smart contracts automatically distributed royalties to all contributors when tracks were streamed or purchased. They also created limited edition merchandise through MetaManufacturing, generating over $50,000 in their first month while maintaining full creative and financial control.

For Artists at Every Stage

Whether you're just starting out or managing an established catalog, our platform scales to meet your needs with appropriate tools for every career stage.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking musicians already leveraging blockchain technology for creative and financial independence. Contact our music specialists for a personalized consultation.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Music Industry Program: "Blockchain Music Mastery"

Program Duration: 8-week program with ongoing support

Program Goals:

  • Establish secure digital ownership of musical works
  • Develop sustainable direct-to-fan revenue streams
  • Build automated royalty distribution systems
  • Create innovative fan engagement strategies
  • Prepare for long-term catalog management and valuation

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for Musicians (1 week)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology for music applications
  • Digital wallet setup and security
  • Music rights and blockchain concepts
  • Industry landscape overview
  • Hands-on: Create secure artist wallet and first transactions

Module 2: Music Rights Protection (2 weeks)

  • Understanding music copyright in the digital age
  • Creating verifiable ownership through NFTs
  • Split sheet implementation via smart contracts
  • Catalog management strategies
  • Hands-on: Mint first composition and recording as NFTs

Module 3: Direct Monetization Strategies (2 weeks)

  • Using MetaManufacturing for artist merchandise
  • Digital and physical product creation
  • Pricing and release strategies
  • Distribution and fulfillment considerations
  • Hands-on: Design and launch first product collection

Module 4: Fan Relationship Development (1 week)

  • Building direct artist-to-fan connections
  • Creating tiered membership experiences
  • Limited edition digital collectibles
  • Community building strategies
  • Hands-on: Implement fan engagement campaign

Module 5: Catalog Valuation and Management (2 weeks)

  • Music catalog as financial asset
  • Tokenization strategies for future royalties
  • Investment structures for music projects
  • Long-term catalog management
  • Hands-on: Create tokenization plan for selected works

Implementation Support:

  • Dedicated music industry success manager
  • Collaboration with existing team members (managers, lawyers)
  • Technical setup assistance
  • Design and marketing guidance
  • Royalty management consultation

Measurement Framework:

  • Direct revenue tracking
  • Fan engagement metrics
  • Royalty distribution efficiency
  • Catalog valuation assessment
  • Platform adoption benchmarks

Resources Provided:

  • Musician-specific implementation guides
  • Contract templates for collaborations
  • Marketing playbooks for releases
  • Fan engagement strategy toolkit
  • Catalog management resources

item.title: AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE PROGRAMS

MetaWork for Agricultural Cooperatives: Cultivate Prosperity with Blockchain Innovation

Empower Farmers with Direct Market Access and Transparent Supply Chains

Agricultural cooperatives face challenges in market access, fair pricing, and supply chain transparency. MetaWork provides farming communities with blockchain-powered tools to create direct market connections, secure fair compensation, and build consumer trust through verifiable practices.

Why Partner with MetaWork for Your Agricultural Cooperative?

  • Direct Market Access: Connect directly with buyers without costly intermediaries
  • Supply Chain Transparency: Document and verify production practices and origins
  • Fair Compensation: Secure equitable payment through automated smart contracts
  • Cooperative Funding: Access innovative financing through tokenized agricultural assets
  • Consumer Relationships: Build direct connections with end consumers of your products

Our Agricultural Solutions Include:

  1. Farm-to-Consumer Portal: Platform connecting producers directly with buyers
  2. Agricultural Certification System: Tools to verify and document sustainable practices
  3. Cooperative Tokenization: Convert agricultural assets into investable tokens
  4. Supply Chain Verification: Transparent tracking from field to consumer
  5. Producer Marketplace: Direct sales platform for cooperative members

Vision Story: Highland Coffee Cooperative

A coffee growers' cooperative in Colombia used MetaWork to tokenize their harvest, allowing consumers and investors to purchase shares in advance. Smart contracts ensured farmers received fair compensation immediately upon delivery, while buyers gained transparent insight into production practices. The cooperative increased farmer income by 40% while building direct relationships with specialty coffee enthusiasts worldwide.

For Cooperatives of All Sizes

Whether you're a small local cooperative or a large regional organization, our platform scales to meet your needs with appropriate tools for operations of any size.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking agricultural cooperatives already leveraging blockchain for greater prosperity. Contact our agricultural specialists for a consultation tailored to your cooperative's needs.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Agricultural Cooperative Program: "Blockchain Farming Future"

Program Duration: 10-week implementation with seasonal support

Program Goals:

  • Introduce cooperative members to practical blockchain applications
  • Implement transparent supply chain documentation systems
  • Develop direct market connections through blockchain
  • Create innovative funding mechanisms for cooperative initiatives
  • Build consumer trust through verifiable agricultural practices

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for Agriculture (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology for agricultural applications
  • Digital wallet setup and security for cooperative members
  • Cooperative governance in blockchain contexts
  • Agricultural blockchain landscape overview
  • Hands-on: Complete cooperative wallet setup and first transactions

Module 2: Supply Chain Transparency (2 weeks)

  • Documenting production practices on blockchain
  • Creating verifiable certifications (organic, fair trade, etc.)
  • Product journey tracking from field to consumer
  • QR integration for consumer transparency
  • Hands-on: Implement production documentation system

Module 3: Direct Market Connections (2 weeks)

  • Setting up cooperative marketplace presence
  • Direct-to-consumer sales strategies
  • Pricing models and smart contract implementation
  • Order fulfillment and logistics coordination
  • Hands-on: Launch pilot direct sales initiative

Module 4: Cooperative Asset Tokenization (2 weeks)

  • Identifying cooperative assets for tokenization
  • Creating investable tokens for pre-harvest funding
  • Revenue distribution models for members
  • Risk management strategies
  • Hands-on: Develop tokenization plan for selected assets

Module 5: Consumer Relationship Building (2 weeks)

  • Storytelling through blockchain verification
  • Creating consumer education materials
  • Developing loyalty programs for direct buyers
  • Building community around cooperative values
  • Hands-on: Implement consumer engagement strategy

Implementation Approaches:

  • Phased rollout by product line
  • Pilot program with select cooperative members
  • Full cooperative implementation
  • Consumer-facing initiatives
  • Buyer partnership frameworks

Measurement Framework:

  • Producer income improvements
  • Market access expansion
  • Price stability metrics
  • Consumer engagement indicators
  • Operational efficiency gains

Resources Provided:

  • Agricultural-specific implementation guides
  • Multilingual training materials for members
  • Consumer education templates
  • Tokenization models for various crops
  • Case studies from similar cooperatives
