EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY PROVIDER PROGRAMS

MetaWork for EdTech Providers: Transform Learning with Blockchain Credentials and Opportunities

Empower Learners with Verifiable Skills and Real Economic Connections

Education technology companies face the challenge of connecting learning with real-world opportunities. MetaWork provides EdTech providers with blockchain-powered tools to create verifiable credentials, connect students with economic opportunities, and build innovative learning ecosystems that bridge education and work.

Why Partner with MetaWork for Your EdTech Platform?

  • Verifiable Credentials: Issue tamper-proof certificates and badges that employers trust
  • Economic Opportunity Connection: Link learning directly to income opportunities
  • Skill Monetization: Help learners earn from their newly acquired skills
  • Learning Incentives: Create token-based rewards for educational achievement
  • Lifelong Learning Portfolios: Build comprehensive skill documentation for learners

Our EdTech Solutions Include:

  1. Credential Issuance System: Platform for creating blockchain-verified certificates
  2. Opportunity Marketplace: Connect learners directly with relevant work opportunities
  3. Skill Tokenization: Convert verified skills into marketable assets
  4. Learning Incentive Framework: Token-based rewards for educational progress
  5. Portfolio Development Tools: Comprehensive skill documentation system

Vision Story: TechSkills Academy

TechSkills Academy integrated MetaWork's credential system into their coding bootcamp, issuing blockchain-verified certificates upon completion. Graduates could immediately access related job opportunities through the MetaJobs platform, with 85% securing income within two weeks of graduation. The academy also implemented a token reward system that incentivized course completion, reducing dropout rates by 40%.

Seamless Integration

Our APIs and integration tools make it easy to incorporate MetaWork's blockchain solutions into your existing EdTech platform, enhancing your offering without disrupting your user experience.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking EdTech providers already leveraging blockchain for greater learner success. Contact our education technology specialists for a consultation tailored to your platform's needs.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork EdTech Provider Program: "Blockchain Learning Ecosystem"

Program Duration: 8-week implementation with ongoing support

Program Goals:

  • Integrate blockchain credential verification into existing platforms
  • Connect learning outcomes directly to economic opportunities
  • Develop incentive systems for educational achievement
  • Create comprehensive skill documentation frameworks
  • Build innovative learning-to-earning pathways

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for EdTech (1 week)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology for educational applications
  • Credential verification concepts and standards
  • Learning ecosystem integration approaches
  • EdTech blockchain landscape overview
  • Hands-on: Complete test credential issuance on blockchain

Module 2: Credential System Implementation (2 weeks)

  • Designing credential architecture for your platform
  • Setting verification standards and processes
  • Creating tamper-proof certificate systems
  • Integration with existing assessment frameworks
  • Hands-on: Implement credential verification system

Module 3: Opportunity Connection Development (2 weeks)

  • Mapping learning outcomes to work opportunities
  • Creating skill-to-job matching algorithms
  • Building opportunity marketplace integration
  • Developing learner preparation resources
  • Hands-on: Launch pilot opportunity connection

Module 4: Learning Incentive Design (1 week)

  • Creating token-based reward systems
  • Designing achievement milestone frameworks
  • Implementing gamification elements
  • Measuring incentive effectiveness
  • Hands-on: Implement learning incentive system

Module 5: Portfolio and Skill Tokenization (2 weeks)

  • Designing comprehensive skill documentation
  • Creating verifiable skill tokens
  • Building portable learning portfolios
  • Developing skill monetization pathways
  • Hands-on: Create skill tokenization framework

Implementation Approaches:

  • Full platform integration
  • Standalone credential module
  • Opportunity marketplace connection
  • Incentive system implementation
  • Portfolio tool development

Technical Integration Support:

  • API documentation and implementation guidance
  • Developer workshops and support
  • User experience design consultation
  • Data migration assistance
  • Testing and quality assurance frameworks

Resources Provided:

  • EdTech-specific implementation guides
  • Integration code examples and libraries
  • User onboarding materials
  • Credential design templates
  • Case studies from similar platforms

item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
HEALTHCARE PROVIDER PROGRAMS

MetaWork for Healthcare Providers: Transform Patient Engagement and Professional Development

Empower Healthcare Teams with Blockchain Solutions for Education and Patient Care

Healthcare organizations face unique challenges in professional development, patient education, and community health initiatives. MetaWork provides hospitals, clinics, and healthcare systems with blockchain-powered tools to create innovative training programs, enhance patient engagement, and develop community health resources.

Why Partner with MetaWork in Healthcare?

  • Professional Development: Create verifiable credentials and continuing education opportunities
  • Patient Education: Develop engaging, incentivized health literacy programs
  • Community Health: Build sustainable community wellness initiatives with transparent funding
  • Research Participation: Increase engagement in clinical studies with fair compensation
  • Healthcare Workforce Development: Train the next generation with practical blockchain skills

Our Healthcare Solutions Include:

  1. Healthcare Credentials Portal: Secure platform for verifiable professional certifications
  2. Patient Education System: Tools to create incentivized health literacy programs
  3. Community Health Initiatives: Blockchain-based funding and tracking for wellness programs
  4. Research Participant Platform: Ethical compensation system for study participants
  5. Healthcare Workforce Development: Training programs for emerging blockchain applications

Vision Story: Riverside Health System

Riverside implemented MetaWork's patient education platform, creating a program where patients earned tokens for completing health education modules. These tokens could be redeemed for health-related merchandise created through MetaManufacturing. Patient engagement increased by 65%, while health literacy scores improved significantly across participating populations.

HIPAA Compliant and Secure

Our healthcare solutions are designed with privacy and compliance at the forefront, ensuring all applications meet or exceed regulatory requirements while leveraging blockchain's security benefits.

Get Started Today

Join forward-thinking healthcare organizations already exploring blockchain applications. Contact our healthcare specialists for a consultation tailored to your organization's needs.

Educational Program Outline

MetaWork Healthcare Program: "Blockchain Health Innovation"

Program Duration: 12-week implementation with specialized tracks

Program Goals:

  • Introduce healthcare professionals to practical blockchain applications
  • Implement credential verification and continuing education systems
  • Develop patient engagement and health literacy initiatives
  • Create transparent community health programs
  • Build capacity for future blockchain healthcare applications

Module 1: Blockchain Fundamentals for Healthcare (2 weeks)

  • Introduction to blockchain technology for healthcare applications
  • Digital wallet setup and security in healthcare contexts
  • Privacy and HIPAA considerations
  • Healthcare blockchain landscape overview
  • Hands-on: Complete secure wallet setup and first transactions

Module 2: Professional Development Track (3 weeks)

  • Creating verifiable credentials on blockchain
  • Continuing education tracking and verification
  • Professional portfolio development
  • Cross-institutional credential sharing
  • Hands-on: Implement credential verification system

Module 3: Patient Engagement Track (3 weeks)

  • Designing incentivized health literacy programs
  • Creating engaging patient education content
  • Developing reward systems for health behaviors
  • Measuring engagement and outcomes
  • Hands-on: Launch pilot patient education initiative

Module 4: Community Health Track (2 weeks)

  • Designing community wellness initiatives
  • Transparent funding mechanisms
  • Community participation incentives
  • Impact measurement frameworks
  • Hands-on: Develop community health program proposal

Module 5: Future Applications Workshop (2 weeks)

  • Exploring emerging blockchain healthcare use cases
  • Research participation frameworks
  • Supply chain applications
  • Data sharing innovations
  • Hands-on: Create implementation roadmap for selected application

Implementation Approaches:

  • Department-specific pilots
  • Organization-wide credential system
  • Patient-focused initiatives
  • Community health partnerships
  • Research collaboration frameworks

Measurement Framework:

  • Professional engagement metrics
  • Patient participation and outcomes
  • Community health indicators
  • Operational efficiency improvements
  • Return on investment analysis

Resources Provided:

  • Healthcare-specific implementation guides
  • Patient education content templates
  • Compliance documentation frameworks
  • Case studies from healthcare organizations
  • Integration guidance for existing systems

item.title: METAWORK INDUSTRY PROGRAMS
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
METAWORK INDUSTRY PROGRAMS

MetaWork Industry Solutions: Empowering Economic Opportunity Across Sectors

At MetaWork, we believe that blockchain technology should be accessible to everyone, creating pathways to economic opportunity regardless of location, background, or traditional credentials. Our industry-specific programs are designed to meet the unique needs of diverse sectors, empowering organizations and individuals to harness the power of blockchain for growth, innovation, and financial inclusion.

Our Industry Solutions

Creative and Cultural Institutions

Our creative sector solutions serve Art Galleries and NIL Athletes, with emerging programs for the Music Industry and Creative Freelancer Collectives. The "Blockchain Art Innovation" program helps galleries authenticate artwork and create new revenue streams, while NCAA athletes leverage our "Digital Brand Mastery" program to maximize their NIL potential. Musicians and creative collectives benefit from rights protection, direct monetization, and collaborative frameworks.

Community Impact Organizations

We empower mission-driven organizations through tailored programs for NGOs and Charities, Community Organizations, and Sports Teams. Our "Blockchain for Social Impact" program helps non-profits implement transparent fundraising and create economic opportunities for beneficiaries, while community centers and libraries become "Digital Opportunity Hubs" connecting members to global earning potential. Sports programs benefit from our "Athlete Economic Empowerment" framework, creating team-based revenue streams and individual financial literacy.

Education Sector

Our education programs transform how students prepare for the future economy, with specialized solutions for Universities, High Schools, and Homeschool environments. From the comprehensive "Blockchain Entrepreneurship Academy" for university students to the family-oriented "Digital Enterprise" program for homeschoolers, we provide age-appropriate, curriculum-aligned resources that blend blockchain education with practical earning opportunities.

Specialized Industry Applications

We're continuously expanding into sectors where blockchain can create transformative impact, including Healthcare Providers, Agricultural Cooperatives, and Education Technology Providers. From verifiable healthcare credentials and patient engagement systems to transparent agricultural supply chains and skill-based learning credentials, these specialized programs address unique industry challenges with blockchain-powered solutions.

The MetaWork Difference

What sets our industry programs apart is our holistic approach to blockchain implementation. Rather than focusing solely on technology, we build comprehensive ecosystems that address the specific needs of each sector:

  • Educational Components: Every program includes tailored training to ensure participants understand not just how to use blockchain tools, but why they matter
  • Economic Opportunity: All solutions incorporate pathways to income generation, whether through MetaJobs, MetaManufacturing, or MetaFinance
  • Implementation Support: Dedicated specialists guide organizations through each stage of adoption
  • Community Connection: Programs connect participants to broader communities of practice for ongoing support

Whether you're an educational institution preparing students for the future, a non-profit seeking greater transparency, a creative organization protecting intellectual property, or a specialized industry exploring blockchain applications, MetaWork offers a tailored program to transform how you operate and create value.

Explore our industry solutions to discover how MetaWork can empower your organization and community with blockchain-powered economic opportunity.

item.title: Where Blockchain Meets Opportunity
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Where Blockchain Meets Opportunity

Empowering individuals and organizations to unlock economic opportunity through blockchain and manufacturing innovation. Become a MetaWorker Book a Demo

For Everyone

Be a Creator

Turn Your Passion Into Profit

Transform your creative skills into sustainable income streams through blockchain-powered opportunities.

  • Protect Your Work: Secure verifiable ownership of your creations as NFTs
  • Direct Monetization: Sell your IP without intermediaries
  • Passive Income: Earn profit while you sleep as Designers discover, use and sell your work on our global marketplaces
  • Automated Royalties: Earn ongoing income from your intellectual property

From digital art to physical merchandise, MetaWork gives creators the tools to build lasting businesses around their talents.

Be a Designer

Design Once, Earn Forever

Design products using images from artists, influencers and brands all over the world, and sell them globally on MetaShop.

  • Design & Earn: Turn any image into merchandise across multiple product categories
  • No Inventory Risk: Print-on-demand model means no upfront costs or storage needs
  • Passive Income: Earn profit while you sleep. MetaWork handles production and shipping to your customers
  • Design Protection: Blockchain verification ensures your intellectual property stays yours

Join thousands of designers already earning through MetaWork's global marketplace.

Be an Investor

Invest in the Creator Economy

Discover and invest in promising creators, intellectual property, and blockchain-based assets.

  • Creator Portfolios: Invest directly in artists and their future earnings potential
  • IP Tokenization: Purchase shares in valuable intellectual property and earn from royalties
  • Diversified Assets: Build portfolios across creative industries and blockchain innovations
  • Transparent Returns: Smart contracts ensure automatic, verifiable profit distribution

Be part of the new economy where creativity meets investment opportunity.

Industries We Serve

Influencer

Own Your Content, Monetize Your Influence

Any Size Following • Any Platform

Transform your social media presence into diversified income streams while maintaining complete ownership of your content and audience relationships.

  • Content Ownership: Protect your creative work as blockchain-verified NFTs with provable ownership
  • Revenue Diversification: Generate income through merchandise, licensing, investments, and direct fan engagement
  • Audience Independence: Build direct relationships with your community beyond platform algorithms
  • Automated Earnings: Earn royalties whenever your content is used, shared, or referenced across platforms
Influencer Programs

Education

Prepare Students for the Digital Future

Universities • High Schools • Homeschool Programs

Integrate blockchain education with real earning opportunities to give students practical skills for tomorrow's economy.

  • Curriculum Integration: Ready-made programs that blend seamlessly with existing coursework
  • Student Earning Opportunities: Help students generate income while learning valuable skills
  • Verifiable Credentials: Issue blockchain-verified certificates that employers trust
  • Future-Ready Skills: Prepare students for careers in the growing blockchain economy
High School Programs Unversity Programs Homeschool Programs

Community Impact

Amplify Your Mission Through Technology

NGOs • Charities • Community Organizations • Sports Teams • NIL Athletes

Leverage blockchain technology to increase transparency, create new funding streams, and provide economic opportunities for your community.

  • Transparent Fundraising: Build donor trust with verifiable fund usage tracking
  • Community Empowerment: Create income opportunities for the people you serve
  • Mission Amplification: Use technology to extend your impact and reach
  • Sustainable Funding: Develop ongoing revenue streams beyond traditional donations
Art Gallery Programs Community Organizations NIL & NCAA Programs NGO & Charity Programs Sports Teams Programs

Creative & Cultural

Revolutionize How You Create and Connect

Art Galleries • Museums • Music Industry • Creative Collectives

Transform how you authenticate, monetize, and share creative works while building deeper audience relationships.

  • Artwork Authentication: Provide verifiable provenance and ownership records
  • New Revenue Streams: Create innovative ways to monetize creative assets
  • Direct Audience Connection: Build relationships without traditional intermediaries
  • Rights Protection: Secure and manage intellectual property through blockchain technology
Art Gallery Programs Music Industry Programs

Specialized Industries

Blockchain Solutions for Unique Challenges

Healthcare • Agriculture • EdTech • Professional Services

Custom blockchain implementations designed for the specific needs and regulations of your industry.

  • Industry Compliance: Solutions built with your regulatory requirements in mind
  • Operational Efficiency: Streamline processes through smart contract automation
  • Trust & Transparency: Build stakeholder confidence with verifiable systems
  • Innovation Leadership: Position your organization at the forefront of blockchain adoption
Agriculture Coopertive Programs Healthcare Provider Programs Education Technology Providers

How MetaWork Works

Connect

Join our platform and connect with a global community of creators, organizations, and opportunities.

Create

Use our tools to protect your intellectual property, build your brand, and develop products or services.

Earn

Generate income through direct sales, royalties, job opportunities, and blockchain-based assets.

Grow

Scale your success with advanced tools, community support, and expanding opportunities.

Book a Demo

Ready to offer blockchain education and economic opportunities to the clients you serve?

Book a demo on the calendar to talk with a representative about what MetaWork can offer your organization.

item.title: Influencers
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Monetize Your Influence, Own Your Content, Build Your Empire

Turn Your Following Into Financial Freedom

As an Influencer, you've built something incredible; a community that trusts you, engages with your content, and values your opinion. But are you truly capturing the full value of what you've created? MetaWork empowers Influencers to transform their digital presence into diversified, sustainable income streams while maintaining complete ownership of their intellectual property.

Stop renting your success from platforms. Start owning it.

THE INFLUENCER CHALLENGE: YOU'VE BUILT IT, BUT DO YOU OWN IT?

Platform Dependency Risk

  • Algorithm changes can destroy your reach overnight
  • Platform policies can demonetize your content without warning
  • You're building someone else's empire while they take the majority of profits

Limited Monetization Options

  • Brand deals are inconsistent and often undervalue your worth
  • Ad revenue sharing gives you pennies on the dollar
  • Merchandise requires upfront investment and inventory management

Content Ownership Issues

  • Your creative work can be stolen without recourse
  • No way to prove original creation or protect intellectual property
  • Limited ability to monetize content across multiple platforms

METAWORK SOLUTIONS: YOUR INFLUENCE, YOUR OWNERSHIP, YOUR PROFITS

CONTENT OWNERSHIP & PROTECTION - Blockchain-Verified Intellectual Property

Transform your content into verifiable digital assets that you truly own.

  • NFT Content Creation: Turn your best posts, videos, and creative works into NFTs with provable ownership
  • Copyright Protection: Blockchain timestamps prove you created content first, protecting against theft
  • Cross-Platform Licensing: License your content to multiple platforms while maintaining ownership
  • Royalty Automation: Earn automatically via blockchain whenever your content is used.

DIVERSIFIED PASSIVE REVENUE STREAMS - Multiple Income Sources Beyond Brand Deals

MetaManufacturing for Influencers:

  • Upload your designs, logos, catchphrases, and artwork
  • Automatic merchandise creation across 100+ product categories
  • No inventory, no upfront costs, no shipping headaches
  • Earn royalties on every sale while we handle fulfillment
  • Your followers get authentic merch, you get passive income

MetaJobs Marketplace:

  • Access high-paying brand collaboration opportunities
  • Set your own rates based on verified engagement metrics
  • Direct contracts with brands, cutting out middleman agencies
  • Transparent payment through smart contracts
  • Build long-term partnerships with recurring revenue

Investment Opportunities:

  • Invest in other creators and earn from their success
  • Tokenize your own future earnings for upfront capital
  • Diversify income beyond your personal brand
  • Access exclusive creator economy investment opportunities

THE METAWORK DIFFERENCE FOR INFLUENCERS

Diversification Over Vulnerability

Instead of relying on a single income source that can disappear overnight, build multiple revenue streams that work together to create financial stability.

Ownership Over Dependency

While other platforms keep you dependent on their algorithms and policies, MetaWork gives you true ownership of your content, audience relationships, and revenue streams.

Innovation Over Imitation

Be among the first Influencers to leverage blockchain technology for content protection, audience ownership, and new monetization models.

Community Over Followers

Transform passive followers into active community members who are invested in your success and willing to pay for exclusive access and experiences.

READY TO OWN YOUR INFLUENCE?

The creator economy is evolving rapidly. Influencers who adapt to blockchain-based ownership and monetization models now will dominate the next decade of digital media.

Don't let another day pass building someone else's empire. Schedule your free, 30-minute Influencer Strategy Call!

item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Product Design: Turn Your Creativity Into Income

Build Your Design Business with MetaWork's Comprehensive Tools

Whether you want to create custom products using artwork from global creators or design completely original 3D products from scratch, MetaWork gives you everything you need to start earning from your designs today.

Two Paths to Design Success

Standard Product Design Process

Use Global IP to Create Custom Products

Design products like shirts, mugs, posters, and accessories using licensed artwork from creators worldwide, then sell them through your personal MetaWork Aisle or major eCommerce platforms.

Standard Product Design Process

Step 1: Select Your Product

Choose from dozens of product categories including:

  • Apparel (shirts, hats, hoodies)
  • Home goods (mugs, glasses, kitchen wraps)
  • Accessories (stickers, magnets, phone cases)
  • Wall art (posters, canvas prints)
  • Pet products (bowls, toys, accessories)

Step 2: Design with Licensed IP

Use MetaWork's robust Design Engine to create your products:

  • License artwork from global artists, creators, and influencers
  • Upload your own original images and graphics
  • Add text, shapes, and effects with professional design tools
  • Edit layers and adjust colors for perfect customization
  • Preview your design on the actual product before finalizing

Step 3: Submit Your Product

Complete your design right from the canvas:

  • Name your product with SEO-friendly titles
  • Set your selling price and profit margins
  • Add product descriptions and tags
  • Submit for instant processing

Our system automatically creates your product listing and integrates it with our global manufacturing partners.

Step 4: Launch Your Aisle

Receive your personalized product page link via email and MetaWork DM:

  • Share your Aisle with family, friends, and followers
  • Promote on social media to reach wider audiences
  • No inventory management - we handle production and shipping
  • Focus on marketing while we manage fulfillment and quality control

Step 5: Earn from Sales

When customers purchase your products:

  • Automatic blockchain payments to your wallet
  • Stablecoin earnings (1 USDC = $1 USD for stability)
  • Transparent transactions with full payment tracking
  • Secure, decentralized payment system

3D Product Creation Process

Transform your ideas into physical products.

Whether you're scanning existing objects, sculpting artistic pieces, or engineering functional items, MetaWork connects your 3D creations to customers worldwide.

3D Product Design Process

Step 1: Choose Your Design Method

Select from three powerful 3D creation approaches:

  • Mobile 3D Sculpting - Create organic shapes, artistic pieces, decorative items
  • Kiri Engine - Convert physical objects into reproducible, sellable products
  • TinkerCAD - Browser-based CAD for engineering and geometric designs

Step 2: Create Your 3D Model

Use your chosen tool to bring your vision to life:

  • Scan existing objects with Kiri Engine using your phone's camera
  • Sculpt organic designs with mobile 3D apps for artistic pieces
  • Engineer functional products using TinkerCAD's geometric tools
  • Preview your model in 3D before finalizing your design

Step 3: Upload & Optimize

Submit your 3D file through our professional processing system:

  • Upload your STL/OBJ file with detailed product information
  • Set your base pricing for both digital and physical sales
  • Add product descriptions and category tags for discoverability
  • Submit for expert review and optimization

Our manufacturing team automatically reviews structural integrity, fixes printing inefficiencies, professionally slices your model, and sets competitive pricing using our local partnerships.

Step 4: Launch Your Aisle

Receive your personalized 3D marketplace listing via email and MetaWork DM:

  • Share your Aisle with customers seeking unique products
  • Promote on social media to reach wider audiences
  • No inventory management - we handle printing and shipping
  • Focus on marketing while we manage fulfillment and quality control

Step 5: Earn from Multiple Streams

When customers purchase your 3D products:

  • Automatic blockchain payments to your wallet
  • Stablecoin earnings (1 USDC = $1 USD for stability)
  • Digital file royalties from customer downloads
  • Print-on-demand royalties from physical product sales
  • Transparent transactions with full sales tracking

Why Choose MetaWork for Product Design?

🔒 Secure IP Protection

  • Blockchain tokenization protects your designs
  • Transparent ownership records
  • Decentralized storage ensures permanent access

🌍 Global Marketplace Access

  • Reach customers worldwide through your Aisle
  • Integration with major eCommerce platforms
  • Access to international manufacturing networks

💡 Comprehensive Design Tools

  • Professional Design Engine for standard products
  • Support for multiple 3D creation methods
  • Extensive library of licensed IP from global creators

⚡ Instant Monetization

  • No waiting periods - start selling immediately
  • Automated payment processing
  • Real-time earnings tracking

🤝 Community Support

  • Weekly AMAs to answer questions
  • Step-by-step tutorials and guides
  • Active community of designers and creators

These units build upon the blockchain fundamentals learned in Unit 0, focusing on creating valuable digital intellectual property that can generate passive income through the MetaWork platform. Students will learn to use free design tools, register their creations as blockchain-secured IP, and apply their designs to physical products for global sale.

MetaFinance Courses

These units build upon the blockchain fundamentals learned in Unit 0, focusing on decentralized finance (DeFi) mechanisms that can generate passive income. Students will learn to use MetaWork's financial tools to stake tokens, earn interest through lending, provide liquidity, and manage risks effectively. By the end of this unit, students will have practical experience with various DeFi strategies and understand how to build sustainable passive income streams.

item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
SECURE MetaWork Academy: Curricula & Pathways

The official training platform for the MetaWork ecosystem. Choose your path to financial freedom through our career-focused Pathways.

Master the Blockchain Skills to Earn, Create, and Invest on MetaWork.

MetaWork is a blockchain-powered platform democratizing global economic opportunities for Workers, Creators, and Investors. Our academic structure provides a clear, progressive path to transform you from a novice into an informed, asset-owning participant in the digital economy.

  • Be an Owner, Not Just a User: Our curriculum is founded on the Ownership Mental Model, ensuring you gain the skills to create, own, and profit from digital assets and IP, not just learn about technology.

  • University-level Knowledge: We offer two distinct career Pathways that build upon a common foundation, allowing you to specialize in either creative business (MetaManufacturing) or advanced finance (MetaFinance).

  • Practical & Hands-On Learning: Every unit focuses on real-world application, including creating a secure wallet, registering original designs as IP, executing DeFi transactions, and launching products on MetaShop and other e-commerce platforms.

Academy Foundation: Core Requirement

All students begin here. This unit establishes the essential blockchain literacy and digital security skills required to operate within the entire MetaWork ecosystem, regardless of the student's chosen pathway.

UnitTitleFocus & Key Outcome
Unit 0 (Core)How to BlockchainFocus: Core blockchain concepts, wallet security, and the Ownership Mental Model. Outcome: Establish a secure blockchain wallet and understand verifiable digital ownership.
[tutor_course category="5143" orderby="ID" order="desc" count="3" column_per_row='3' course_filter='off' show_pagination='on']

MetaManufacturing Pathway

This Pathway is a complete creative and business track, designed for students who want to create tangible and digital assets, establish verifiable ownership, or build a sustainable business by selling and licensing their Intellectual Property (IP) on the MetaWork platform.

UnitTitleDescription & Key Outcomes
1 Design & IP Creation

The Creator's Toolbox: Students master basic design principles and free software (Canva, GIMP). They learn to create professional assets and register them as Intellectual Property (IP) on MetaWork.

Outcome: Students will have a portfolio of marketable designs and the ability to register them as income-generating IP assets.

2Sales & Client Acquisition

The Entrepreneurial Phase: Focuses on monetizing the IP created in Unit 2. Students learn marketing, direct-to-consumer (D2C) sales, and professional business development.

Outcome: Students will launch products on the MetaShop, develop marketing strategies, and successfully negotiate wholesale licensing deals for passive income.

[tutor_course category="5124" orderby="date" order="desc" count="3" column_per_row='3' course_filter='off' show_pagination='on']

MetaFinance Pathway

This Major focuses on financial empowerment, teaching students how to move beyond merely earning income to actively managing, investing, and growing their wealth using Decentralized Finance (DeFi) tools within the MetaWork ecosystem.

UnitTitleDescription & Key Outcomes
1 Blockchain Financial Products

Passive Income Generation: Students learn the principles of DeFi and how to use MetaWork's financial tools for wealth building.

Outcome: Students gain practical experience with staking, lending, and borrowing protocols to build a diversified portfolio and generate sustainable passive income streams.

[tutor_course category="5125" orderby="date" order="desc" count="3" column_per_row='3' course_filter='off' show_pagination='on']

Free Introductory Lessons

Ready to see how blockchain can transform your financial life? Get a risk-free start with the first two essential lessons from our Core Requirement unit. No commitment required.

LessonFocus
Lesson 1: What is Blockchain?Understand blockchain's core features and why it enables secure digital ownership on MetaWork.
Lesson 2: Wallets & KeysLearn the fundamental security principles and the exact steps to create and secure your personal blockchain wallet.
[tutor_course id="660438, 660690" orderby="ID" order="asc" count="3" column_per_row='3' course_filter='off' show_pagination='on']

Ready to Start?

Enroll now and take control of your financial future. The skills learned here apply globally, regardless of your location or background, setting you up for financial sovereignty on the MetaWork platform.

Tools You'll Need (All Units):

  • Device with internet access.
  • MetaWork account with wallet setup (Completed in Unit 0).
  • Free software like Canva and GIMP (Unit 1).
  • Spreadsheet software like Google Sheets for sales tracking (Unit 2).

item.title: Thought Leadership
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
3D Printing is Key to Winning the Innovation War with China

We couldn’t agree more with the anonymous writer who penned The World Needs to Grow a Pair to Stop China. But not only must we stop China, we must also protect our own interests and recreate American Self-Reliance. Sadly, the situation described in How Not to Lose Your IP When Developing a Product with Your China Factory is all too common. But there is a homegrown solution that is faster, safer and more cash flow friendly than ordering containers from China. The solution is additive manufacturing, a/k/a 3D printing, which was invented by an American, Dr, Chuck Hull, in 1986….


Read More





How the West Can Win the Innovation Race With China

THE US-CHINA COLD WAR NOW, THE EU-CHINA COLD WAR LATER China and America are in a Cold War and innovation is the new Arms Race. This can be seen by the nearly unlimited government resources China has put into areas where the United States (and to a somewhat lesser extent, the EU and Japan and a few others) have traditionally been the world leaders: Electronic Communications and Software, Space Exploration, Military Weapons, Energy and Biometrics. China’s actions to dominate the world in these areas include the following: In China Doubles Down on Industry Subsidies: No Exit, this blog described how…


Read More





China and the Future of American Jobs

Since China joined the WTO in 2001, the US has imported $6,747,513,000,000 ($6.7 Trillion) in goods from China.Let that sink in. In 2019 alone, the US imported $450 Billion from China. That’s four times the economic output of the entire state of Mississippi for the same year. That’s $450 Billion of American’s money that should have gone to Americans to develop American communities. $450 Billion that could have been spent with American businesses so they can expand their businesses and hire more Americans. Though it might not have been classified as an “economic miracle,” the $6.7 Trillion-plus the US has…


Read More

What Is SECURE MetaWork?

SECURE MetaWork is a creator-commerce platform that connects:

  • Suppliers: artists, influencers, and product designers who upload IP, design products (2D and 3D), and earn royalties
  • Consumers: fans, patrons, and communities who buy unique products through the Showroom and personal Aisles

What you get: blockchain-backed ownership, stablecoin payouts, global manufacturing partners, and a storefront system (Aisles) for every creator and organization.

Two Sides, One Ecosystem

Businesses & Creators

Product Creation Tools enable you to upload and discover IP, as well as design and sell unique product lines:

  • Upload IP and license IP instantly
  • Create 500+ standard products
  • Create 3D products via digital scan or sculpting
  • Launch your Aisle (personal storefront)

item.title: Gyms and Sports
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Gyms & Fitness

Build team identity and recurring revenue with branded gear, athlete collabs, and community-designed drops.

Who It's For

  • Martial arts academies, CrossFit boxes, school/club teams, personal trainers
  • Fitness creators and NIL athletes

What You Can Launch

  • Team merch: rash guards, shorts, hoodies, bags, patches
  • Athlete and coach signature lines
  • Limited-edition drops tied to events or promotions
  • Member-designed collabs with revenue sharing

How It Works

  1. Upload logos/IP or license artwork from creators
  2. Design products in the MetaWork Design Engine (or upload 3D designs)
  3. Launch your Aisle (instant storefront) and share QR codes in-gym
  4. We handle production and shipping; you focus on training and promotion
  5. Earn automatically via on-chain payouts (stablecoins)

Why MetaWork for Fitness

  • No inventory; on-demand manufacturing
  • Fast fulfillment through regional partners
  • NIL-ready tools for compliant athlete earnings
  • Unified storefront for all teams, programs, and athletes

[Get Started for Gyms] • [See Fitness Products in the Showroom →]

item.title: Schools & Universities
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Schools & Universities

Give students, clubs, and departments a modern way to create, sell, and learn.

Who It's For

  • Districts, schools, colleges, clubs, athletics, dorms, makerspaces
  • Student entrepreneurs, art/design classes

What You Can Launch

  • Official school/club merch; dorm and event drops
  • Student-creator licensing programs
  • Fundraising collections for teams and causes
  • Learning modules: product design, 3D, entrepreneurship, finance

How It Works

  1. Create school/org account and enable student Aisles
  2. Students design products or upload IP for licensing
  3. Approve and publish collections by program or club
  4. Share Aisle links across campus and events (QR-friendly)
  5. Automated payouts with admin reporting

Why MetaWork for Campus

  • Real-world learning with real revenue
  • Compliance-friendly earnings and permissions
  • No-cost, no-inventory fundraising at scale
  • Portfolio-building for admissions and careers

[Campus Solutions] • [Student/Club Onboarding]

item.title: Food & Beverage
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Food & Beverage

Turn brand love into product lines and community revenue.

Who It's For

  • Breweries, roasters, cafes, restaurants, CPG startups

What You Can Launch

  • Taproom/roastery merch designed by fans and local artists
  • Seasonal drops tied to new releases, festivals, and holidays
  • Mug clubs, memberships, tokenized gift cards
  • Branded 3D-printed tap handles, signage, coasters

How It Works

  1. Upload brand assets and set style guidelines
  2. Invite local artists/fans to submit designs (license IP automatically)
  3. Approve and publish collections to your Aisle
  4. Place QR codes at tables, menus, and packaging
  5. We fulfill orders; you collect margins and deepen loyalty

Why MetaWork for F&B

  • Fresh, hyperlocal designs from your community
  • No staff overhead for inventory/fulfillment
  • Built-in licensing and revenue sharing
  • Easy to test seasonal/limited runs

[F&B Playbook] • [See F&B Items in the Showroom →]

item.title: Retailers & Merchandisers
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Retailers & Merchandisers

Expand product offerings and test new lines without inventory risk or upfront capital.

Who It's For

  • Boutiques, gift shops, pop-up retailers, concept stores
  • Online stores, marketplace sellers, dropshippers
  • Event merchandisers and festival vendors

What You Can Launch

  • Private label product lines designed in-house or by local artists
  • Exclusive collaborations with regional creators and influencers
  • Seasonal and trend-driven collections tested on-demand
  • Niche products (apparel, home goods, accessories, 3D-printed items)
  • Co-branded merchandise with complementary brands

How It Works

  1. Browse MetaWork's IP marketplace or upload your own designs
  2. Design products using our catalog or submit 3D files
  3. Create retailer Aisle with your branding and product collections
  4. Integrate Aisle link with your existing eCommerce, socials, or POS
  5. We manufacture on-demand and ship direct-to-consumer or to your location

Why MetaWork for Retailers

  • Zero inventory investment; test products before committing
  • Expand SKU count without warehouse space or cash flow pressure
  • Access global creator network for fresh, licensable designs
  • Quick turnaround from design to fulfillment
  • Transparent, automated royalty payments to IP creators
  • Seamless integration with existing sales channels

Use Cases

  • Gift Shops: Offer locally-designed mugs, prints, and accessories without stocking shelves
  • Boutiques: Launch seasonal apparel drops with zero MOQ
  • Pop-Ups/Events: Create event-specific merch on-demand; no leftover inventory
  • Online Retailers: Add new product categories instantly; scale without risk

item.title: Nonprofits & Workforce Development
item.dc:creator: SECUREMetaWork
item.content:encoded:
Nonprofits & Workforce Development

Activate your mission with transparent, community-driven commerce.

Who It's For

  • 501(c)(3)s, social enterprises, training providers, public sector programs

What You Can Launch

  • Donor-trusted, trackable merch campaigns
  • Beneficiary-designed product lines (skills-to-income)
  • Workforce training: 2D/3D design, storefront ops, marketing
  • Collaborations with schools, gyms, and local brands

How It Works

  1. Set up org Aisle with impact messaging
  2. Onboard participants to upload IP/design products
  3. Launch cause-based collections with clear revenue splits
  4. Share Aisle links in newsletters, events, and socials
  5. Report outcomes with on-chain transparency and dashboards

Why MetaWork for Nonprofits

  • Transparent funding and impact reporting
  • Real work experience + real income for participants
  • Partnerships baked in (campus, fitness, F&B)
  • Scale programs without inventory or logistics

[Nonprofit Programs] • [Workforce Development] • [Case Studies]

item.title: About Tokenization
item.dc:creator: jeffykings
item.content:encoded:
MetaWork: Tokenize Everything

Our tools enable retail consumers, solopreneurs, SMB's and global companies to access the blockchain to:

  1. Design, manufacture, and deliver customized products to global consumers via our browser-based, user-friendly Design Engine.
  2. Defend Intellectual Property (IP) Rights via our NFT minting process which establishes an immutable record of ownership.
  3. Hire MetaWork Consultants on a "pay per task" basis for tasks such as sales, marketing, social media management, etc.
  4. Manage financial responsibilities and transactions, such as investor dividends or payroll; transparently, securely and instantly.

Why Tokenization?

"Tokenization," enables decentralized access, by anyone in the world, to physical assets like real estate or art; financial assets like equities or bonds; and intangible assets like task-based work or intellectual property (IP). "Tokenizing" real-world assets (RWA) has the following benefits:

  1. Creates an immutable, transparent record of all transactions involving said asset.
  2. Enables trustless transactions via smart contract (no lawyers needed). Assets are only released when conditions are filled.
  3. 24/7/365 access to financial records, transactions and payouts.

How it Works

The creation process differs slightly depending on the asset being "tokenized," but essentially, the MetaWork platform creates and issues unique, digital certificates (NFTs) that represent real things. These NFTs can then be used, bought, sold, or traded at-will by the owner, representing the buying, selling or trading of the asset itself.

The value of these NFTs are determined by the value of the asset that was tokenized. For example:

  1. An artist can "tokenize" a drawing (IP), then set a royalty price for anyone that wants to use the IP in their own work. When someone pays the royalty, they're given access to the IP. The value of the NFT is whatever the artists decides.
  2. An entrepreneur can "tokenize" a start up, allowing for decentralized, crowd-sourced investment. Upon entering, investors are issued an NFT representing their stake in the venture. This NFT would be used to claim dividends, instantly, any time. The value of the NFT is determined by the revenue of the business.
  3. Exporters/Importers can "tokenize" shipments, releasing payment, instantly, upon meeting agreed upon conditions (eg, passing port inspection). The value of the NFT is determined by the cost of goods.
  4. A village can "tokenize" a cow, enabling each member of the community (that's been issued an NFT) to earn a pre-determined percentage of the profit when the cow gets sold. The value of the NFT is determined by the final sale price of the cow.

How does a Web3 asset get tokenized?

There are four typical steps involved in asset tokenization:

  1. Asset sourcing - The first step of tokenization is figuring out how to tokenize the asset in question. Tokenizing a money market fund, for example, will be different from tokenizing a carbon credit. This process will require knowing whether the asset will be treated as a security or a commodity and which regulatory frameworks apply. MetaWork typically uses some type of a Liquidity Pool (LP).
  2. Digital-asset issuance and custody. If the digital asset has a physical counterpart, the latter must be moved to a secure facility that’s neutral to both parties. Then a token, a network, and compliance functions are selected—coming together to create a digital representation of the asset on a blockchain. Access to the digital asset is then stored pending distribution. MetaWork maintains a physical presence whenever physical assets are involved.
  3. Distribution and trading. The investor will need to set up a digital wallet to store the digital asset. Depending on the asset, a secondary trading venue—an alternative to an official exchange that is more loosely regulated—may be created for the asset. MetaWork's tokenized assets can be traded on decentralized exchanges and marketplaces.
  4. Asset servicing and data reconciliation. Once the asset has been distributed to the investor, it will require ongoing maintenance. This should include regulatory, tax, and accounting reporting; notice of corporate actions; and more. MetaWork provides training classes on portfolio management best practices.

MetaWork manages most of the technical stuff on the backend. The only exception, is that because we're non-custodial, your assets will be kept in a secure crypto wallet that only you can access; and will use it to off ramp into fiat currency at any time. We do, however provide training on how to create and manage a wallet.

item.title: IP-Upload
item.dc:creator: jeffykings
item.content:encoded:
Upload Your IP & Start Earning

Turn Your Creative Work Into Income Streams

Intellectual Property (IP): Your original creations including artwork, designs, photography, graphics, and digital content that can be licensed by designers worldwide.

MetaWork's blockchain-powered platform protects your creative work through tokenization (NFT minting) and connects you directly with designers who want to license your IP for products sold globally. No lawyers, no complicated contracts – just upload and start earning immediately.

How It Works: From Upload to Income

1. Upload Your IP

Fill out the form below and upload your creative files. We accept JPG, JPEG, and PNG formats up to 10 files per submission.

2. Instant Processing

Your IP is automatically assessed and processed by our system – no waiting period required.

3. Automatic Publishing

Your IP immediately appears on your MetaWork Aisle page where designers can discover and license it right away.

4. Promote Your Aisle

Share your Aisle link on social media, with your network, or anywhere you want to showcase your available IP for licensing.

5. Designers License & Use

Designers browse your Aisle, license your IP for their product designs, and create merchandise sold on MetaShop.

6. You Get Paid

Earn royalties every time a designer licenses your IP, plus ongoing earnings when products featuring your work are sold.

What You Can Expect

Processing Time: Instant – your IP goes live immediately
Pricing: You set your licensing price per use
Ongoing Earnings: Royalties from both licensing and product sales
Global Reach: Designers worldwide can discover and use your work instantly
Protection: Blockchain verification ensures your ownership rights
Growth: Build your reputation and increase licensing demand over time

Community Guidelines

MetaWork maintains a professional, inclusive environment welcoming all ages, races, and genders. Please ensure your uploads do not contain:

  • Hate speech, slurs, or discriminatory material
  • Threats, violence, or harmful content
  • Copyright infringement or stolen work
  • Adult/explicit content
  • Low-quality or pixelated images

Our automated system helps maintain quality standards, and our community reporting features ensure the marketplace remains professional and welcoming.

Pro Tip: The better you describe your IP with relevant tags and keywords, the easier it is for designers to discover and license your work. Think about what products your design would work well on and include those terms in your description.

Ready to Upload Your IP?

Complete the form below and your IP will be live on your Aisle and ready for licensing within minutes of upload.

[lumise_artist_dashboard]

Growth: Build your reputation and increase licensing demand over time

Community Guidelines

MetaWork maintains a professional, inclusive environment welcoming all ages, races, and genders. Please ensure your uploads do not contain:

  • Hate speech, slurs, or discriminatory material
  • Threats, violence, or harmful content
  • Copyright infringement or stolen work
  • Adult/explicit content
  • Low-quality or pixelated images

Our automated system helps maintain quality standards, and our community reporting features ensure the marketplace remains professional and welcoming.

Pro Tip: The better you describe your IP with relevant tags and keywords, the easier it is for designers to discover and license your work. Think about what products your design would work well on and include those terms in your description.

Ready to Upload Your IP?

Complete the form below and your IP will be live on your Aisle and ready for licensing within minutes of upload.

item.title: Customize Product
item.dc:creator: jeffykings
item.content:encoded:
Design a Product

Create Custom Products Using Global IP & Start Selling Today

The MetaWork Design Engine transforms blank products into personalized merchandise using licensed artwork from creators worldwide. Here's how to go from idea to income:

What You'll Do:

  1. Select a product from the categories below (shirts, mugs, accessories, etc.)
  2. Enter the Design Engine where you'll see your chosen product as a customizable canvas
  3. Browse and license artwork from our global creator marketplace, or upload your own images
  4. Customize your design using professional tools: resize, rotate, add text, adjust colors, and layer elements
  5. Preview your finished product in realistic mockups before finalizing
  6. Save and price your design - set your selling price and profit margins

After You Complete Your Design:

  • Buy for yourself - Order your custom product for personal use, gifts, or samples
  • Create your Aisle - We'll automatically generate your personal storefront with your new product
  • Start selling immediately - Share your Aisle link and begin earning from sales
  • We handle everything else - Production, shipping, and customer service are managed by MetaWork

Your design will be live and ready for purchase within minutes of completion. Focus on creating and marketing while we handle the logistics.

Ready to start? Select a product below to begin designing:

item.title: Monetize Your IP
item.dc:creator: IP Review Team
item.content:encoded:
Monetize Your Work

SECURE MetaWork empowers artists and creators to monetize their work by providing a secure, transparent platform for global designers to pay artists for using their IP to design a product.

Step 1 - Submit IP

The first step is submitting your IP (Intellectual Property) for approval. Give your art a title, name your price, and hit submit. Your IP will be reviewed and you’ll be notified in 48 – 72 hours, by email and MetaWork DM, if your IP is approved.

We currently accept image files and 3D print files.

Submit Your IP Here

Step 2 - Tokenize

Behind the scenes, our IP Review Team tokenizes your IP and transparently stores it in a cryptographically secure, decentralized digital vault: no one gets in without the key (ie, NFT).

“Decentralized” means it’s stored all over the world, so you’ll always have access. Tokenization is more complex, but the button below explains everything.

How Does Tokenization Work?

Step 3 - Sell

Once approved, you’ll receive a link to a page that has all your work displayed. This is your “Aisle.” You should share this link with family, friends and followers.

Designers will then pay you each time they sell a product that uses your art. Products include: shirts, mugs, posters, etc.

Check out work submitted by others by following the button below.

See a Creator's Aisle

Step 4 - Get Paid

When you make a sale, you’ll receive a blockchain stablecoin payment in your “wallet.”

We use blockchain because it’s fastest (~3 sec), cheapest (< $0.01), most secure and transparent way to send money. We send stablecoins because their value is stable (1 USDC = $1 USD).

Don’t know what a wallet is? It’s easy. Just check out the button below.

Get Your Pera Wallet

Attend an AMA

Still got questions?

We host a weekly AMA to answer all of your questions and help you get started.

Regsiter & Create

item.title: MetaWork Design Engine - Tools
item.dc:creator: IP Review Team
item.content:encoded:
The MetaWork Design Engine Tools

The MetaWork Design Engine has eight tools located on the left side of the design editor, where you can add and customize elements to your product.

1 - 3. Templates, Clipart and Images (TCI)Free and paid TCI can be effortlessly added to your product design. To select a TCI, select it and/or drag it onto the product. Details such as name, price, etc. will appear on the TCI selection panel. You can quickly sort Images using the categories tab. 4. ProductThis tab includes product info and attributes. From here, you
  • set your product color and size
  • tell us if you wish to sell the product with MetaWork
  • tell us if you wish to order the product for yourself (and how many you wish to order)

As you add different images to the product, the price will be updated automatically.

5. TextThere are hundreds of fonts and text styles to choose from. Select your chosen text, then drag into the product and edit.

6. Shapes

Shapes are in vector format, meaning the can be resized without loss of quality. ‌To use a shape, select it, drag it onto your product, then edit it.

7. Layers

Each design element you add creates a new layer. All layers which you added to the product will display on this tab. You can show/hide layers via the visibility option or delete layers.

‌You can drag and drop the layers to change the order (what's on top/bottom). You can Lock/Unlock layers to Disable/Enable editing for that particular layer.

8. Drawing

You can free draw on your design as well. Select the color and the size of the bush, then draw what you want onto the product.

item.title: MetaWork Design Engine - Canvas
item.dc:creator: IP Review Team
item.content:encoded:
Canvas

This is the most important part of the design engine. It is a preview for all added layers/elements. Select an element to edit or drag to a new location.

The Canvas includes:

  • Object editor: Customize the selected object color and effect.

  • Zoom tools: Scroll to zoom in or zoom out.

  • Stages switcher: switch between different print areas (eg, front/back, left/right sleeve, etc.)

  • Design area: Image printing boundaries

  • Toolbars: The options for selected layers include arrangement, transform, and position.

Image Toolbar

1. Replace Image - Upload an image from your device to replace the image in the current layer.

2. Crop Image - The crop image feature allows you to crop the image, to exclude portions of it.

3. Image Mask - This allows you to put a background into your text. 4. Remove Background - Works well for images with clear contrast. 5. Image Filter Effects - Start with 20 of our professionally designed filters, then customize to your own liking.

Layout Toolbar

There are four options on the upper right toolbar that allow you to customize the picture position, transform, and color. To enable the layout toolbar, click on an image, and it'll appear on the top of the design editor.

1. Fill Color - Shape, image, and text are the three objects that you can apply this fill option.

To use the tool:

  1. Drag your mouse to select the layer you want to fill color.

  2. Click on the Fill Color icon on the toolbar.

  3. Select a color from preset colors or enter a custom value by click on input Click to choose color.

  4. To save custom color just press the plus (+) button next to add.

  5. Transparent help you change the opacity of the filled color.

  6. Stroke width + Stroke color allow you to make the border color for the current layer.

2. Arrange LayersThe Design Engine works base on layers. Quickly arrange the selected object position either backward or forward.

To use this tool:

  1. Chose the layer you want to change.

  2. Click on the Arrange Layers icon on the toolbar.

  3. Select Forward or Back action to change the object order.

3. PositionThe Layer Position tool allows you to place the selected object in an exact position with one click. Switch the Lock object position to YES, if you want to continue design without affect the current object.

To use this tool:

  1. Select the layer you want to move

  2. Click on the Position icon on the toolbar

  3. Choose the position you wish to move the layer to.
4. Transform Tool - Provides a manual way to set transform values for a layer.

To use this tool:

  1. Chose the layer you want to change.
  2. Click on the Transform icon on the toolbar.
  3. Adjust the values you want to set.

You can:

  • Rotate: the edge of an object. start from 0 – 360

  • Skew X: skews layer along the X-axis by the given angle

  • Skew Y: skews layer along the Y-axis by the given angle

  • Flip X: Horizontal flip your layer

  • Flip Y: Vertical flip your layer.

You can cancel all applied values by pressing the Reset All button.

Text Toolbar

Select any text layer and this toolbar will appear on top of the canvas.

1. Font Family Allows you to switch to another font family.

2. Advanced Font - This tool allows you to change the font-size, line-height and text content 3. Text Effects - Select a text and choose the Text Effect icon to customize it. 4. Text Style - Tools for bold, underline, italic, or text-align.

Menu Bar

Access the main menu by pressing the hamburger navigation bar located in the top left corner (the 3 lines).

1. File

  • Import file: Import design from your local which you exported from Lumise.

  • Clear all: Clear current design to empty.

  • Save to My Designs: Save your current design to My Designs.

  • Save as file: current export content on design area to a file

2. My Designs

This function manages all of your designs on your current account. You can duplicate, edit, and delete any saved design.

3. Help - A quick guide to keyboard shortcuts. 4. Undo/Redo - Remove or replace the most recent edit.

item.title: MetaWork Whitepaper
item.dc:creator: IP Review Team
item.content:encoded:
Unlocking Global Economic Opportunity with Blockchain Innovation - A MetaWork Whitepaper

Table of Contents:

  1. Executive Summary
  2. The Problem: Barriers to Economic Opportunity
  3. MetaWork’s Solution: A Decentralized, Inclusive Platform
    • Access to Work
    • Access to Ownership
    • Access to Tools
    • Access to Training
  4. How MetaWork Works: Key Features and Functionality
  5. MetaWork in Action: Real-World Use Cases
  6. Impact and Benefits for Users
  7. Competitive Landscape: Why MetaWork Stands Out
  8. Why MetaWork Is the Future of Economic Empowerment

1. Executive Summary

MetaWork is a blockchain-powered platform designed to democratize global economic opportunities. By addressing systemic barriers to financial inclusion and employment, MetaWork empowers individuals to earn income, own assets, and manage resources securely. This Whitepaper highlights the platform's features, real-world applications, and competitive advantages, showcasing why MetaWork is a transformative solution for investors and users alike.

2. The Problem: Barriers to Economic Opportunity

Despite advancements in technology, significant global challenges persist:

  • Financial Exclusion: Over 1.7 billion adults globally remain unbanked as of 2023 (Global Findex, World Bank). Without access to banks, they cannot save, invest, or transact securely.
  • Unemployment and Underemployment: According to the International Labour Organization (ILO), 207 million people globally were unemployed in 2022, with youth unemployment rates reaching 15.6%—more than three times the rate of adults. Many more individuals are underemployed, working informal or unstable jobs that do not provide sustainable income.
  • Low Wages in Developing Economies:
    • The average daily wage of workers in low-income countries is estimated at just $3.70 per day, according to the International Labour Organization.
    • This is far below the UN’s poverty threshold of $6.85 per day (2022), leaving millions of workers struggling to meet basic needs.
    • Nearly 40% of workers in low-income countries currently live in extreme poverty, with earnings insufficient to support themselves or their families.
  • Future Projections:
    • Based on World Bank and ILO analyses, the number of workers in low-income countries living in poverty is expected to grow to 43% by 2030 if current economic trends persist.
    • Factors such as climate change, inflation, and geopolitical instability are projected to drive an additional 50-70 million workers globally into extreme poverty over the next 5–10 years.

These barriers disproportionately affect individuals in developing regions, cutting them off from global economic opportunities.

MetaWork bridges these gaps by creating an ecosystem where anyone can earn, own, and manage assets securely, regardless of their location or background.

3. MetaWork’s Solution and How It Works

MetaWork is a comprehensive platform that empowers users of all kinds—Workers, Creators, and Investors—by providing access to blockchain-powered tools and opportunities. This section outlines the user journey for each type of user, explaining how they interact with the platform’s tools and services to achieve their goals. Whether it’s earning income, designing products, or generating passive revenue streams, MetaWork offers a seamless experience for all its users.

User Journey Overview

MetaWork caters to three types of users:

  1. Workers: Engage with MetaJobs to complete tasks such as surveys, in-game activities, and other opportunities to earn crypto.
  2. Creators: Use MetaManufacturing tools to upload intellectual property (IP) for licensing or design products for sale.
  3. Investors: Leverage MetaFinance tools to generate passive income through staking, trading, loan/lend services, and tokenized revenue streams.

Workers: Gaining Access to Global Job Opportunities

Step 1: Registration and Wallet Setup

  • Workers register on MetaWork and create a blockchain wallet.
  • Wallets are essential for receiving payments, and MetaWork provides guides and tutorials to simplify the process. In the future, wallet creation will be automated and secured using the user’s email, similar to ImmutableX.

Step 2: Finding Jobs

  • Workers navigate to the MetaJobs tab and select "View Jobs" to browse available opportunities.
  • Jobs include:
    • Surveys: Primarily market research and sentiment surveys, with more partnerships being developed to expand job types and regional availability.
    • In-Game Tasks: Tasks vary depending on the game, providing a fun and engaging way to earn.
  • Workers can review job summaries and do their own research to pick jobs they enjoy.

Step 3: Completing Jobs and Earning

  • Blockchain projects pay Workers directly into their wallets for completed jobs.
  • For off-chain tasks, MetaWork sends payments monthly. MetaWork also covers transaction fees for these off-chain payouts.
  • Workers are paid only in crypto, but MetaWork’s service department assists with off-ramping solutions in their country. In the future, native off-ramping features will be introduced.

Additional Features for Workers

  • Gamified Tracking System: MetaWork tracks Worker reliability and expertise, offering a gamified system to reward consistency.
  • No Upfront Costs: Workers can participate without upfront costs, making the platform accessible to all.

Creators: Monetizing Creativity Through MetaManufacturing

IP Owners: Uploading and Licensing Intellectual Property

  1. Registration and IP Upload:

    • IP Owners register on the platform and use the "Upload Your IP" feature under the MetaManufacturing tab.
    • Uploaded IP (e.g., images, logos, artwork) undergoes a 24-72 hour review process to ensure compliance with submission guidelines. Upon approval, the IP is minted as an NFT and sent to the Owner.
    • If rejected, Owners receive feedback explaining why their submission didn’t meet the requirements.
  2. Revenue Generation:

    • Once approved, the IP is made available for Product Designers to use in creating merchandise.
    • IP is priced per-use/per-sale. If the same IP is used twice on a single product, the owner will be paid twice each time the product sells.
    • Royalties are distributed automatically via Smart Contracts, ensuring transparency and fairness.

Product Designers: Designing and Selling Products

  1. Design Tools:

    • Designers access the "Create Your Own Product" feature under the MetaManufacturing tab.
    • The design engine includes:
      • Drag-and-drop functionality.
      • Basic design elements like shapes and fonts are pre-loaded and free to use. Images from artists and influencers are available on a per use/per sale basis. Designers can also upload their own images for private use only.
  2. Submitting and Selling Products:

    • Designers create products (e.g., shirts, mugs, stickers) and submit them for approval. Approved designs are added to the MetaShop, where consumers can purchase them.
    • Both IP Owners and Designers receive a dedicated "Aisle" page displaying their IP and products.

Monitoring Sales and Earnings

  • Creators can monitor sales, earnings, and customer engagement metrics via a dedicated dashboard.

Investors: Generating Passive Income with MetaFinance Tools

Step 1: Navigating MetaFinance Tools

  • Investors register and immediately access the MetaFinance section, which offers tools for:
    • Swapping: Convert between cryptocurrencies.
    • Staking: Join staking pools to earn rewards.
    • Loan/Lend Services: Lend or borrow crypto securely.
    • Asset Purchases: Invest in tokenized revenue streams on the MetaWork Marketplace.

Step 2: Revenue Streams on the Marketplace

Examples of tokenized revenue streams include:

  • Rewards from P2E games.
  • Revenue from surveys completed by other MetaWorkers.
  • Stake pool rewards.
  • Akash GPU rental income.
  • Sales from a local bakery or other small businesses.

Step 3: Earning and Payouts

  • Investments generate returns that are paid out immediately upon receipt of revenue.
  • Payouts are automated via Smart Contracts and can be customized based on agreements between Investors and Owners.

Risk Management and Portfolio Diversification

  • All investments are transparent on the blockchain, and Investors are alerted of potential risks.
  • The marketplace categorizes tokens to help Investors diversify their portfolios. Additional tools to enhance portfolio management are in development.

Platform-Wide Features for All Users

Support and Training

  • Onboarding: MetaWork offers videos, written guides, and live AMA sessions to help new users get started.
  • Service Department: A dedicated support team (staffed by MetaWorkers!) is accessible via MetaTalk, the platform’s internal messaging system.
  • Notifications: Users are notified of important updates, such as IP approvals, payouts, and other key actions.

Accessibility

  • MetaWork’s tools are designed to be user-friendly, even for those new to blockchain technology.
  • Future updates will focus on streamlining wallet creation, introducing off-ramp functionality, and expanding regional support.

Why MetaWork’s Solution Matters

MetaWork is more than just a platform—it’s an ecosystem that breaks down barriers to global economic participation. By providing Workers, Creators, and Investors with tools to earn, own, and invest, MetaWork creates a decentralized, inclusive platform that empowers individuals to take control of their financial futures.

4. Real-World Example: How MetaWork Transforms Lives

  1. Worker Success Story: A young gamer from the Mexico earns crypto by completing in-game tasks through MetaJobs. With their earnings, they invest in tokenized assets on the MetaWork Marketplace, creating a sustainable income stream.
  2. Creator Success Story: A painter from the USA uploads their IP to MetaManufacturing and earns consistent royalties when Product Designers use their artwork for merchandise.
  3. Investor Success Story: A small bakery in Nigeria secures funding from Investors on MetaWork, expanding their operations and creating jobs in their community.

5. Blockchain Technology: The Backbone of MetaWork

At the heart of MetaWork lies blockchain technology, enabling transparency, security, and efficiency. The platform leverages blockchain to empower users in the following ways:

1. Transparency and Trust

  • Every transaction on MetaWork is recorded on the blockchain, providing a tamper-proof ledger.
  • Users can independently verify job payments, royalty distributions, and investment returns.

2. Quantum-Proof Security

  • MetaWork leverages quantum-proof cryptographic algorithms (Algorand), ensuring long-term protection against future hacking technologies. This makes the platform resilient and secure for decades to come.

3. Smart Contracts

  • Smart Contracts automate all payment processes, including:
    • Worker payments for completed jobs.
    • Royalty distributions between IP Owners and Product Designers.
    • Investor payouts from tokenized revenue streams.
  • These contracts eliminate the need for intermediaries, reducing costs and delays.

4. Decentralized Data Storage

  • MetaWork uses InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) for decentralized file storage.
  • This ensures IP Owners’ designs and Product Designers’ merchandise remain secure and accessible only to authorized users.

5. Scalability and Accessibility

  • MetaWork is built to support millions of users globally, with plans to integrate low-bandwidth solutions for underserved regions.
  • Future updates will include automatically created wallets and native off-ramping functionality for crypto earnings.

6. Interoperability

  • MetaWork supports multiple blockchain ecosystems, allowing users to work with their preferred networks and tokens.
  • This flexibility enhances user experience and expands the platform’s reach.

6. Impact and Benefits for Users

MetaWork is more than a platform—it is a transformative ecosystem that empowers individuals to participate in the global economy. By combining blockchain-powered tools with a user-centric approach, MetaWork addresses systemic barriers to economic opportunity and creates a fairer, more inclusive world. Emphasizing Overarching Benefits

MetaWork bridges the gap for the 1.7 billion unbanked adults worldwide (World Bank 2023) by providing access to earning opportunities, secure asset ownership, and investment tools. With no reliance on traditional banking systems, MetaWork enables individuals in underserved regions to participate in the global economy.

MetaWork empowers its users to take control of their financial futures by offering tools to earn, create, and invest:

  • Creators monetize their intellectual property and products.
  • Investors generate wealth through tokenized revenue streams.

This holistic approach supports long-term wealth creation and reduces reliance on unstable or informal jobs.

3. Accessibility for All

MetaWork is designed with inclusivity in mind, ensuring that users from all backgrounds can participate:

4. Transparency and Security

Blockchain technology ensures fair payouts, secure transactions, and tamper-proof ownership records:

  • Smart Contracts automate payments, removing the need for intermediaries.

MetaWork creates localized economic opportunities while connecting users to global markets:

  • Global Reach: Users can sell products, complete tasks, or invest in projects from anywhere in the world.
  • Social Good: The platform supports marginalized groups, such as women and rural workers, by providing flexible earning opportunities and tools for entrepreneurship.

A black American in Mississippi raises capital to start a bakery via the MetaWork Marketplace. The bakery expands operations, creating local jobs, while the investor earns a share of the bakery’s profits via tokenized revenue streams.

The MetaWork Advantage

MetaWork’s unique combination of tools for Workers, Creators, and Investors creates a synergistic ecosystem where users can:

7. Competitive Landscape: Why MetaWork Stands Out

The Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization space is rapidly evolving, with several platforms emerging to tokenize assets like real estate, art, and commodities. However, MetaWork sets itself apart by offering a broader scope, greater inclusivity, and enhanced accessibility for its users. Below is a detailed comparison of MetaWork with other prominent RWA platforms like Lofty.ai and similar competitors.

MetaWork’s Unique Value Proposition

1. Democratizing Economic Opportunities

MetaWork is not just an investment platform—it’s an ecosystem where anyone can participate in the global economy. From earning crypto through MetaJobs to creating and monetizing IP with MetaManufacturing, MetaWork enables users to become active participants in wealth creation, rather than passive investors.

2. Diversified Revenue Streams

By tokenizing everything, MetaWork provides its users with access to a diverse range of revenue streams, including:

  • P2E game rewards.

This diversification reduces risk and allows users to build a portfolio tailored to their goals and interests.

3. Accessibility for Small-Scale Investors

MetaWork’s use of blockchain technology enables micro-investments, empowering users to invest even the smallest amounts. This inclusivity is a game-changer for individuals in developing nations or those with limited disposable income.

4. Technology-Driven Transparency

Unlike traditional RWA platforms, MetaWork’s blockchain infrastructure ensures:

  • Complete transparency: All transactions, royalties, and payouts are publicly verifiable.

MetaWork is not just another RWA platform—it’s a revolutionary ecosystem that empowers individuals to engage with the global economy in ways that were previously inaccessible. By tokenizing everything and making the platform open to everyone, MetaWork is poised to redefine the real-world asset space and create opportunities for billions of people worldwide.

Key Differences Between MetaWork and Other RWA Platforms

2. Generality: Tokenizing Everything vs. Specialization

  • MetaWork:

    • MetaWork is a general-purpose RWA platform that tokenizes everything—from P2E game rewards and survey revenues to real estate, product royalties, and even GPU rentals.
    • This all-encompassing approach creates a diverse marketplace where users can invest in or generate revenue from any type of asset, enabling creators, workers, and investors to participate in the economy in new and innovative ways.

    • Platforms like Lofty.ai are highly specialized, focusing solely on tokenizing real estate. While they offer fractional ownership of real estate properties, their scope is limited to a single asset class.
